name: daily-pipeline

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 17 * * *'          # 00:30 WIB
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full_refresh:
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: daily-pipeline
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}

jobs:
  generate:                         # hanya untuk simulasi; hapus bila OLTP diisi aplikasi nyata
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r oltp/generator/requirements.txt
      - run: python oltp/generator/generate.py daily --date "$(TZ=Asia/Jakarta date -d yesterday +%F)"
        env:
          SOURCE_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}

  ingest:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r ingestion/requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_INGEST }}
      - run: python ingestion/pipeline.py
        env:
          SOURCE_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}
          DESTINATION__BIGQUERY__LOCATION: asia-southeast2
          DESTINATION__BIGQUERY__CREDENTIALS__PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}

  transform:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: ingest
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: dbt
    env:
      DBT_PROFILES_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/dbt
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_DBT }}
      - run: dbt deps
      - run: dbt source freshness --target prod
      - name: dbt build (full refresh mingguan tiap Senin dini hari, atau manual)
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.full_refresh }}" = "true" ] || [ "$(TZ=Asia/Jakarta date +%u)" = "1" ]; then
            dbt build --target prod --full-refresh
          else
            dbt build --target prod
          fi
      # Dokumentasi bukan jalur kritis: gangguan sesaat (mis. timeout token OIDC/WIF) di-retry, dan bila tetap
      # gagal tidak menandai job transform gagal sehingga export-dashboard tetap berjalan.
      - name: dbt docs generate (non-kritis, retry 3x)
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            dbt docs generate --target prod && exit 0
            echo "::warning::dbt docs generate gagal (percobaan $attempt/3), coba lagi dalam 20 detik"
            sleep 20
          done
          exit 1
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: prod-manifest
          path: |
            dbt/target/manifest.json
            dbt/target/run_results.json
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Siapkan artefak dokumentasi bersih
        id: prep_docs
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f target/index.html ]; then
            mkdir -p docs_site
            cp target/index.html target/manifest.json target/catalog.json docs_site/ 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "has_docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "has_docs=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        if: steps.prep_docs.outputs.has_docs == 'true'
        with:
          path: dbt/docs_site

  deploy-docs:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.transform.result == 'success'
    needs: transform
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    continue-on-error: true
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
    steps:
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

  export-dashboard:                 # JSON mart -> dashboard Vercel
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: transform
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r dashboard/requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_EXPORT }}
      - run: python dashboard/export_marts.py
        env:
          GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}
      - name: Commit data bila berubah (memicu deploy Vercel)
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add dashboard/public/data
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(dashboard): refresh data $(date -u +%F)"
            git pull --rebase origin main || { git rebase --abort; exit 1; }
            git push origin main || (sleep 3 && git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin main)
          fi

name: pr-ci

on:
  pull_request:
    paths: ['dbt/**', 'scripts/**', 'dashboard/**', 'ingestion/**', '.github/workflows/**']

concurrency:
  group: pr-ci-${{ github.event.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  dbt-ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: dbt
    env:
      GCP_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}
      DBT_PROFILES_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/dbt
      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars.SA_CI }}
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v3
      - run: dbt deps

      - name: PII guard
        run: python ../scripts/check_pii_columns.py models

      - name: Ambil manifest prod terakhir
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --workflow daily_pipeline.yml --branch main --status success --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' || true)
          if [ -n "$RUN_ID" ] && [ "$RUN_ID" != "null" ]; then
            gh run download "$RUN_ID" --name prod-manifest --dir prod_state || true
          fi

      - name: Lint SQL yang berubah (non-blocking dulu)
        run: |
          CHANGED=$(git diff --relative --name-only --diff-filter=AM "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}...HEAD" -- models | grep '\.sql$' || true)
          if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then
            sqlfluff lint $CHANGED --format github-annotation-native --nofail
          fi

      # sa-github-ci tidak punya akses ke raw_fnb / hr_restricted (PII). Model yang membaca raw langsung
      # (staging, hr/restricted) hanya di-compile; turunannya dibangun dengan defer ke versi prod. View stg prod
      # tetap terbaca karena dataset stg di-otorisasi pada raw_fnb (infra/restrict_raw_ci_access.py).
      - name: Compile model yang membaca raw langsung
        run: dbt compile --target ci --select "path:models/staging" "path:models/hr/restricted"

      - name: Slim CI build
        run: |
          EXCLUDE='path:models/staging path:models/hr/restricted'
          if [ -f prod_state/manifest.json ]; then
            dbt build --target ci --select state:modified+ --exclude $EXCLUDE --defer --state prod_state
          else
            dbt build --target ci --exclude $EXCLUDE
          fi

      - name: Hapus dataset CI
        if: always()
        run: |
          for ds in $(bq ls --max_results=1000 --format=json --project_id "$GCP_PROJECT_ID" | jq -r '.[].datasetReference.datasetId' | grep -E "^dbt_ci_pr${PR_NUMBER}(_|$)" || true); do
            bq rm -r -f -d "$GCP_PROJECT_ID:$ds"
          done

name: wif-smoke-test

# Gate Fase 0: membuktikan GitHub Actions bisa autentikasi ke GCP tanpa JSON key,
# dan akses tiap service account sesuai least privilege. Jalankan manual dari tab Actions.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {name: sa-ingest, sa_var: SA_INGEST, can_read: raw_fnb,  cannot_read: marts}
          - {name: sa-dbt,    sa_var: SA_DBT,    can_read: raw_fnb,  cannot_read: ""}
          - {name: sa-export, sa_var: SA_EXPORT, can_read: marts,    cannot_read: raw_fnb}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
      - name: Auth (WIF, tanpa key) sebagai ${{ matrix.name }}
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v3   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ vars.WIF_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ vars[matrix.sa_var] }}
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@v3   # TODO Fase 7: pin ke commit SHA
      - name: Akses dataset yang diizinkan harus berhasil
        run: bq ls --project_id="${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}" "${{ matrix.can_read }}"
      - name: Akses dataset terlarang harus ditolak
        if: ${{ matrix.cannot_read != '' }}
        run: |
          if bq ls --project_id="${{ vars.GCP_PROJECT_ID }}" "${{ matrix.cannot_read }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::error::${{ matrix.name }} seharusnya TIDAK bisa membaca ${{ matrix.cannot_read }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: akses ke ${{ matrix.cannot_read }} ditolak seperti yang diharapkan"

import datetime as dt
import json

from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from google.cloud import bigquery

def _json_default(value):
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return int(value) if value % 1 == 0 else float(value)
    if isinstance(value, (dt.date, dt.datetime)):
        return value.isoformat()
    raise TypeError(f"tipe tidak didukung: {type(value)}")


def main() -> None:
    client = bigquery.Client(project=PROJECT, location=LOCATION)
    config = bigquery.QueryJobConfig(
        maximum_bytes_billed=2_000_000_000,
        labels={"app": "dashboard_export"},
    )
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    counts = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    data_through = None

    for name, sql in EXPORTS.items():
        sql = sql.format(p=PROJECT).replace(f"`{PROJECT}.marts.", f"`{PROJECT}.{MARTS_DATASET}.")
        result = client.query(sql, job_config=config).result()
        banned = [f.name for f in result.schema if BANNED_COLUMNS.search(f.name)]
        if banned:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: kolom terlarang untuk dipublikasikan: {banned}")
        raw_rows = [dict(r.items()) for r in result]
        rows = []
        for r in raw_rows:
            clean_row = {}
            for k, v in r.items():
                if isinstance(v, Decimal):
                    clean_row[k] = int(v) if v % 1 == 0 else float(v)
                elif isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
                    clean_row[k] = int(v)
                else:
                    clean_row[k] = v
            rows.append(clean_row)

        if name == "pnl_daily" and rows:
            dates = [r["report_date"] for r in rows if r.get("report_date")]
            if dates:
                data_through = max(dates)
                if isinstance(data_through, (dt.date, dt.datetime)):
                    data_through = data_through.isoformat()

        payload = json.dumps(rows, default=_json_default, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
        file_bytes = len(payload.encode("utf-8"))
        if file_bytes > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            raise SystemExit(f"{name}: melebihi batas {MAX_FILE_BYTES} byte ({file_bytes} byte); agregasi atau perkecil jendela tanggal")
        if file_bytes >= WARN_FILE_BYTES:
            print(f"::warning::{name} mencapai {file_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB (>= 80% dari batas 2.5 MB)!")

        (OUT / f"{name}.json").write_text(payload, encoding="utf-8")
        counts[name] = len(rows)
        total_bytes += file_bytes
        print(f"Exported {name}: {len(rows)} rows ({file_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB)")

    meta = {
        "generated_at_utc": dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "data_through": data_through,
        "rows": counts,
        "total_size_kb": round(total_bytes / 1024, 1),
    }
    (OUT / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, sort_keys=True, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Export marts to JSON selesai dengan sukses! Total data: {total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB (data through {data_through})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

with dates as (
    select date_day from {{ ref('util_dates') }}
),

events as (
    select * from {{ ref('id_calendar_events') }}
),

ramadan_days as (
    select distinct
        d.date_day,
        true as is_ramadan
    from dates as d
    inner join events as e
        on e.event_type = 'Ramadan'
        and d.date_day between e.start_date and e.end_date
),

holiday_days as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        string_agg(e.event_name, ', ' order by e.start_date, e.event_name) as holiday_name,
        string_agg(distinct e.event_type, ', ') as holiday_type,
        true as is_holiday
    from dates as d
    inner join events as e
        on e.event_type != 'Ramadan'
        and d.date_day between e.start_date and e.end_date
    group by 1
)

select
    d.date_day,
    extract(year from d.date_day)                   as year,
    extract(quarter from d.date_day)                as quarter,
    extract(month from d.date_day)                  as month,
    extract(isoyear from d.date_day)                as iso_year,
    extract(isoweek from d.date_day)                as iso_week,
    extract(dayofweek from d.date_day)              as day_of_week_num,
    format_date('%A', d.date_day)                   as day_of_week_name,
    extract(dayofweek from d.date_day) in (1, 7)    as is_weekend,
    extract(day from d.date_day) >= 25
      or extract(day from d.date_day) = 1           as is_payday_window,
    coalesce(h.holiday_name, case when r.is_ramadan then 'Ramadan' end) as calendar_event,
    coalesce(h.holiday_type, case when r.is_ramadan then 'Ramadan' end) as calendar_event_type,
    coalesce(h.is_holiday, false)                   as is_holiday,
    coalesce(r.is_ramadan, false)                   as is_ramadan
from dates as d
left join ramadan_days as r
    on d.date_day = r.date_day
left join holiday_days as h
    on d.date_day = h.date_day

    partition_by = {'field': 'balance_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'ingredient_id'],
    on_schema_change = 'fail',
    pre_hook = "{{ guard_incremental_relation(required_column='on_hand_qty') }}",
    tags = ['inventory', 'daily']
  )
}}
/*
  Grain   : 1 baris = balance_date x outlet_id x ingredient_id (bahan raw), spine padat (hari tanpa transaksi ikut)
  Saldo   : on_hand_qty = stock count terakhir + Σ pergerakan bersih sesudahnya (perpetual, di-reset tiap opname).
            Prep item yang dihitung saat opname dikonversi ke ekuivalen bahan raw (sama dengan mart_inventory_variance).
            Pada hari opname: count_variance_qty = counted_qty - (saldo kemarin + pergerakan hari itu) = susut/selisih.
  Incremental (tanpa menghitung ulang seluruh histori):
    1. Bangun ulang ringkasan pergerakan harian (murah, ~28 rb baris) lalu bandingkan dengan isi tabel.
    2. Tanggal pertama yang berbeda (hari baru, order telat, koreksi receipt) → rebuild_from = awal bulannya.
    3. Saldo dilanjutkan dari baris tabel tanggal rebuild_from - 1 (seed); 27 hari sebelumnya ikut dibaca
       sebagai konteks rata-rata pemakaian 28 hari. Partisi bulan >= rebuild_from ditimpa (insert_overwrite).
*/
with

ingredients as (
    select ingredient_id
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }}
    where not is_prep_item
),

outlets as (
    select outlet_id from {{ ref('dim_outlet') }}
),

movements as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_inventory_movements_daily') }}
),

stock_counts as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_stock_counts') }}
),

counts as (
    select
        c.outlet_id,
        c.count_date,
        coalesce(x.ingredient_id, c.ingredient_id)                          as ingredient_id,
        sum(c.counted_qty_base * coalesce(x.qty_per_unit, 1))               as counted_qty
    from stock_counts as c
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i
        on c.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
    left join {{ ref('int_item_explosion_daily') }} as x
        on
            i.is_prep_item
            and c.count_date = x.date_day
            and c.ingredient_id = x.item_id
            and x.item_type = 'Prep Item'
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

end_date as (
    select greatest(
        (select max(m.movement_date) from movements as m),
        (select max(sc.count_date) from stock_counts as sc)
    ) as max_date
),

daily as (
    select
        d.date_day                                                          as balance_date,
        o.outlet_id,
        i.ingredient_id,
        coalesce(m.purchased_qty, 0)                                        as purchased_qty,
        coalesce(m.purchased_amount, 0)                                     as purchased_amount,
        coalesce(m.theoretical_sales_qty, 0)                                as theoretical_sales_qty,
        coalesce(m.waste_qty, 0)                                            as waste_qty,
        c.counted_qty
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    cross join end_date as e
    cross join outlets as o
    cross join ingredients as i
    left join movements as m
        on
            d.date_day = m.movement_date
            and o.outlet_id = m.outlet_id
            and i.ingredient_id = m.ingredient_id
    left join counts as c
        on
            d.date_day = c.count_date
            and o.outlet_id = c.outlet_id
            and i.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id
    where d.date_day between {{ var('start_date') }} and e.max_date
),

{% if is_incremental() %}
existing as (
    select
        balance_date,
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        purchased_qty,
        purchased_amount,
        theoretical_sales_qty,
        waste_qty,
        counted_qty,
        on_hand_qty,
        last_count_date
    from {{ this }}
),

first_changed as (
    select min(coalesce(d.balance_date, t.balance_date)) as first_changed_date
    from daily as d
    full outer join existing as t
        on
            d.balance_date = t.balance_date
            and d.outlet_id = t.outlet_id
            and d.ingredient_id = t.ingredient_id
    where
        d.balance_date is null
        or t.balance_date is null
        or d.purchased_qty is distinct from t.purchased_qty
        or d.purchased_amount is distinct from t.purchased_amount
        or d.theoretical_sales_qty is distinct from t.theoretical_sales_qty
        or d.waste_qty is distinct from t.waste_qty
        or d.counted_qty is distinct from t.counted_qty
),

rebuild as (
    -- tidak ada perubahan → tanggal jauh di depan → output kosong → tidak ada partisi yang ditimpa
    select date_trunc(coalesce(fc.first_changed_date, date '9999-12-31'), month) as rebuild_from
    from first_changed as fc
),

seed as (
    select
        t.outlet_id,
        t.ingredient_id,
        t.on_hand_qty       as seed_on_hand_qty,
        t.last_count_date   as seed_last_count_date
    from existing as t
    cross join rebuild as r
    where t.balance_date = date_sub(r.rebuild_from, interval 1 day)
),

usage_context as (
    select
        t.outlet_id,
        t.ingredient_id,
        t.balance_date,
        t.theoretical_sales_qty + t.waste_qty   as usage_qty
    from existing as t
    cross join rebuild as r
    where t.balance_date between date_sub(r.rebuild_from, interval 27 day) and date_sub(r.rebuild_from, interval 1 day)
),
{% endif %}

to_compute as (
    select
        d.*,
        d.purchased_qty - d.theoretical_sales_qty - d.waste_qty             as net_movement_qty,
        {% if is_incremental() %}
            s.seed_on_hand_qty,
            s.seed_last_count_date
        {% else %}
            cast(null as numeric)                                           as seed_on_hand_qty,
            cast(null as date)                                              as seed_last_count_date
        {% endif %}
    from daily as d
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        cross join rebuild as r
        left join seed as s
            on
                d.outlet_id = s.outlet_id
                and d.ingredient_id = s.ingredient_id
        where d.balance_date >= r.rebuild_from
    {% endif %}
),

segmented as (
    select
        *,
        -- segmen 0 = sebelum opname pertama di jendela ini (dilanjutkan dari seed); segmen n dimulai pada opname ke-n
        countif(counted_qty is not null) over (
            partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id order by balance_date
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as count_segment
    from to_compute
),

balanced as (
    select
        *,
        if(
            count_segment = 0,
            coalesce(seed_on_hand_qty, 0) + sum(net_movement_qty) over seg,
            first_value(counted_qty) over seg + sum(net_movement_qty) over seg - first_value(net_movement_qty) over seg
        ) as on_hand_qty,
        if(
            count_segment = 0,
            seed_last_count_date,
            first_value(balance_date) over seg
        ) as last_count_date
    from segmented
    window seg as (
        partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id, count_segment order by balance_date
        rows between unbounded preceding and current row
    )
),

with_variance as (
    select
        *,
        if(
            counted_qty is null,
            null,
            counted_qty - (
                coalesce(
                    lag(on_hand_qty) over (partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id order by balance_date),
                    seed_on_hand_qty,
                    0
                ) + net_movement_qty
            )
        ) as count_variance_qty
    from balanced
),

usage_series as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        balance_date,
        theoretical_sales_qty + waste_qty   as usage_qty
    from with_variance
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        union all
        select * from usage_context
    {% endif %}
),

usage_28d as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        balance_date,
        avg(usage_qty) over (
            partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id order by balance_date
            rows between 27 preceding and current row
        ) as avg_daily_usage_28d
    from usage_series
),

costs as (
    select
        date_day,
        item_id             as ingredient_id,
        std_cost_per_unit
    from {{ ref('int_item_std_cost_daily') }}
    where item_type = 'Ingredient'
)

select
    b.balance_date,
    b.outlet_id,
    b.ingredient_id,
    b.purchased_qty,
    b.purchased_amount,
    b.theoretical_sales_qty,
    b.waste_qty,
    b.net_movement_qty,
    b.counted_qty,
    b.count_variance_qty,
    b.on_hand_qty,
    b.last_count_date,
    date_diff(b.balance_date, b.last_count_date, day)                       as days_since_last_count,
    u.avg_daily_usage_28d,
    safe_divide(b.on_hand_qty, u.avg_daily_usage_28d)                       as days_on_hand,
    b.on_hand_qty < 0                                                       as is_negative_on_hand,
    c.std_cost_per_unit,
    b.on_hand_qty * c.std_cost_per_unit                                     as on_hand_value
from with_variance as b
inner join usage_28d as u
    on
        b.outlet_id = u.outlet_id
        and b.ingredient_id = u.ingredient_id
        and b.balance_date = u.balance_date
left join costs as c
    on
        b.balance_date = c.date_day
        and b.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id

    union all
    select outlet_id, movement_date, ingredient_id, 0, qty, 0, 0

files.dbt/models/core/fct_opex_allocated_month:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['finance', 'monthly']
  )
}}

with actual_opex as (
    select
        e.period_month,
        e.outlet_id,
        c.pnl_line,
        sum(e.amount) as amount,
        false as is_opex_estimated
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__operating_expenses') }} as e
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__expense_categories') }} as c on c.category_code = e.category_code
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

outlet_months as (
    select
        date_trunc(d.date_day, month)   as period_month,
        o.outlet_id,
        count(*)                        as active_days_in_month
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__outlets') }} as o
        on d.date_day between o.opened_date and coalesce(o.closed_date, date '9999-12-31')
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
      and d.date_day <= last_day(current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}'), month)
    group by 1, 2
),

latest_actual as (
    select max(period_month) as max_actual_month from actual_opex
),

accrued_opex as (
    select
        m.period_month,
        a.outlet_id,
        a.pnl_line,
        a.amount,
        true as is_opex_estimated
    from (
        select distinct om.period_month
        from outlet_months as om
        cross join latest_actual as l
        where l.max_actual_month is not null
          and om.period_month > l.max_actual_month
    ) as m
    cross join (
        select a.outlet_id, a.pnl_line, a.amount
        from actual_opex as a
        inner join latest_actual as l on a.period_month = l.max_actual_month
    ) as a
),

all_opex as (
    select * from actual_opex
    union all
    select * from accrued_opex
),

sales_months as (
    select date_trunc(order_date, month) as period_month, outlet_id, sum(net_sales_amount) as net_sales
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2
),

basis as (
    select
        om.period_month,
        om.outlet_id,
        om.active_days_in_month,
        coalesce(sm.net_sales, 0)                                           as net_sales,
        count(*) over (partition by om.period_month)                        as n_outlets,
        sum(coalesce(sm.net_sales, 0)) over (partition by om.period_month)  as total_net_sales
    from outlet_months as om
    left join sales_months as sm
        on sm.period_month = om.period_month and sm.outlet_id = om.outlet_id
),

direct_cost as (
    select
        coalesce(b.period_month, o.period_month) as period_month,
        coalesce(b.outlet_id, 'Unallocated')     as outlet_id,
        o.pnl_line,
        o.amount                                 as allocated_amount,
        coalesce(b.active_days_in_month, extract(day from last_day(o.period_month))) as active_days_in_month,
        if(b.outlet_id is null, 'Unallocated', 'Direct') as allocation_type,
        o.is_opex_estimated
    from all_opex as o
    left join basis as b on b.period_month = o.period_month and b.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    where o.outlet_id is not null
),

shared_cost as (
    select
        coalesce(b.period_month, o.period_month) as period_month,
        coalesce(b.outlet_id, 'Unallocated')     as outlet_id,
        o.pnl_line,
        case
            when b.outlet_id is null then o.amount
            else o.amount * coalesce(
                safe_divide(b.net_sales, b.total_net_sales),
                safe_divide(cast(1 as numeric), cast(b.n_outlets as numeric))
            )
        end as allocated_amount,
        coalesce(b.active_days_in_month, extract(day from last_day(o.period_month))) as active_days_in_month,
        if(b.outlet_id is null, 'Unallocated', 'HQ Allocation') as allocation_type,
        o.is_opex_estimated
    from all_opex as o
    left join basis as b on b.period_month = o.period_month
    where o.outlet_id is null
)

select * from direct_cost
union all
select * from shared_cost
files.dbt/models/core/fct_order_lines.sql:
{{
  config(
    materialized = 'incremental',
    incremental_strategy = 'insert_overwrite',
    partition_by = {'field': 'order_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'day'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'menu_item_id'],
    on_schema_change = 'fail',
    pre_hook = "{{ guard_incremental_relation() }}",
    tags = ['finance', 'daily']
  )
}}
/*
  Grain   : 1 baris = 1 order_item_id
  Aturan  : is_revenue_line = order Completed AND line Served
            diskon level order dialokasikan pro-rata ke (gross - line_discount)
            diskon yang didanai Platform TIDAK mengurangi net sales merchant
            COGS standar = qty × (std cost menu + std cost modifier) pada tanggal order
  Incremental: insert_overwrite per order_date. Partisi yang dibangun ulang = tanggal order yang order /
            item / modifier-nya berubah sejak watermark (lihat macros/incremental.sql) → late-arriving
            order (sync H+1 dst) masuk ke partisi tanggal order aslinya, partisi lain tidak disentuh.
*/
with
{% if is_incremental() %}
changed_dates as (
    select o.order_date
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o
    where o.updated_at_utc >= {{ late_arriving_watermark() }}

    union distinct

    select o.order_date
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_items') }} as i
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    where i.updated_at_utc >= {{ late_arriving_watermark() }}

    union distinct

    select o.order_date
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_item_modifiers') }} as m
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__order_items') }} as i on i.order_item_id = m.order_item_id
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    where m.updated_at_utc >= {{ late_arriving_watermark() }}
),
{% endif %}

orders as (
    select o.*
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        where o.order_date in (select cd.order_date from changed_dates as cd)
    {% endif %}
),

items as (
    select i.*
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_items') }} as i
    inner join orders as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
),

item_costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_item_std_cost_daily') }}
),

modifiers as (
    select
        m.order_item_id,
        sum(m.price_delta)                          as modifier_price_per_unit,
        sum(coalesce(c.std_cost_per_unit, 0))       as modifier_cost_per_unit,
        max(m.updated_at_utc)                       as modifier_updated_at_utc
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_item_modifiers') }} as m
    inner join items as i on i.order_item_id = m.order_item_id
    inner join orders as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    left join item_costs as c
        on c.item_type = 'Modifier'
       and c.item_id = m.modifier_id
       and c.date_day = o.order_date
    group by 1
),

promotions as (
    select promo_code, funded_by from {{ ref('stg_pos__promotions') }}
),

lines as (
    select
        i.order_item_id,
        i.order_id,
        o.order_date,
        o.ordered_at_local,
        o.outlet_id,
        o.channel_code,
        o.customer_id,
        i.menu_item_id,
        o.order_status,
        i.line_status,
        o.order_status = 'Completed' and i.line_status = 'Served'           as is_revenue_line,
        i.qty,
        i.unit_price,
        coalesce(m.modifier_price_per_unit, 0)                              as modifier_price_per_unit,
        i.qty * (i.unit_price + coalesce(m.modifier_price_per_unit, 0))     as gross_sales_amount,
        i.line_discount_amount,
        o.order_discount_amount,
        coalesce(p.funded_by, 'Merchant')                                   as order_discount_funded_by,
        mc.std_cost_per_unit + coalesce(m.modifier_cost_per_unit, 0)        as std_cost_per_unit,
        greatest(
            o.updated_at_utc,
            i.updated_at_utc,
            coalesce(m.modifier_updated_at_utc, i.updated_at_utc)
        )                                                                   as source_updated_at_utc
    from items as i
    inner join orders as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
    left join modifiers as m on m.order_item_id = i.order_item_id
    left join promotions as p on p.promo_code = o.promo_code
    left join item_costs as mc
        on mc.item_type = 'Menu Item'
       and mc.item_id = i.menu_item_id
       and mc.date_day = o.order_date
),

allocated as (
    select
        *,
        if(
            is_revenue_line,
            coalesce(order_discount_amount * safe_divide(
                gross_sales_amount - line_discount_amount,
                sum(if(is_revenue_line, gross_sales_amount - line_discount_amount, 0)) over (partition by order_id)
            ), 0),
            0
        ) as allocated_order_discount_amount
    from lines
),

final as (
    select
        *,
        if(is_revenue_line,
           line_discount_amount
           + if(order_discount_funded_by = 'Merchant', allocated_order_discount_amount, 0),
           0)                                                               as merchant_discount_amount,
        if(order_discount_funded_by = 'Platform', allocated_order_discount_amount, 0)
                                                                            as platform_funded_discount_amount
    from allocated
)

select
    order_item_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    ordered_at_local,
    outlet_id,
    channel_code,
    customer_id,
    menu_item_id,
    order_status,
    line_status,
    is_revenue_line,
    qty,
    unit_price,
    modifier_price_per_unit,
    gross_sales_amount,
    line_discount_amount,
    allocated_order_discount_amount,
    order_discount_funded_by,
    merchant_discount_amount,
    platform_funded_discount_amount,
    if(is_revenue_line, gross_sales_amount - merchant_discount_amount, 0)  as net_sales_amount,
    std_cost_per_unit,
    if(is_revenue_line, qty * std_cost_per_unit, 0)                        as cogs_std_amount,
    source_updated_at_utc
from final
files.dbt/models/core/fct_orders.sql:
{{

*/
with

changed_dates as (

    union distinct

    from {{ ref('stg_pos__payments') }} as p
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o on o.order_id = p.order_id
    where p.updated_at_utc >= {{ late_arriving_watermark() }}

    union distinct

    select fl.order_date
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as fl
    where fl.source_updated_at_utc >= {{ late_arriving_watermark() }}
),
{% endif %}

orders as (
    select o.*
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }} as o
    {% if is_incremental() %}
        where o.order_date in (select cd.order_date from changed_dates as cd)
    {% endif %}
),

lines as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(gross_sales_amount)         as gross_sales_amount,
        sum(merchant_discount_amount)   as merchant_discount_amount,
        sum(net_sales_amount)           as net_sales_amount,
        sum(cogs_std_amount)            as cogs_std_amount,
        sum(qty)                        as units,
        max(source_updated_at_utc)      as source_updated_at_utc
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where
        is_revenue_line
        {% if is_incremental() %}
            and order_date in (select cd.order_date from changed_dates as cd)
        {% endif %}
    group by 1
),

payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(amount)                                                 as paid_amount,
        sum(mdr_fee_amount)                                         as payment_fee_amount,
        string_agg(distinct payment_method order by payment_method) as payment_methods,
        max(updated_at_utc)                                         as updated_at_utc
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__payments') }}
    where order_id in (select o.order_id from orders as o)
    group by 1
),

rates as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__channel_commission_rates') }}
)

select
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    o.ordered_at_local,
    o.order_hour_local,
    o.outlet_id,
    o.channel_code,
    o.customer_id,
    o.promo_code,
    o.order_status,
    o.guest_count,
    coalesce(l.gross_sales_amount, 0)                               as gross_sales_amount,
    coalesce(l.merchant_discount_amount, 0)                         as merchant_discount_amount,
    coalesce(l.net_sales_amount, 0)                                 as net_sales_amount,
    coalesce(l.cogs_std_amount, 0)                                  as cogs_std_amount,
    coalesce(l.units, 0)                                            as units,
    o.service_charge_amount,
    o.tax_amount,
    o.total_amount,
    coalesce(p.paid_amount, 0)                                      as paid_amount,
    coalesce(p.payment_fee_amount, 0)                               as payment_fee_amount,
    p.payment_methods,
    coalesce(r.commission_pct, 0)                                   as commission_pct,
    if(o.order_status = 'Completed',
       coalesce(l.net_sales_amount, 0) * coalesce(r.commission_pct, 0) / 100,
       0)                                                           as channel_commission_amount,
    greatest(
        o.updated_at_utc,
        coalesce(p.updated_at_utc, o.updated_at_utc),
        coalesce(l.source_updated_at_utc, o.updated_at_utc)
    )                                                               as source_updated_at_utc
from orders as o
left join lines as l on l.order_id = o.order_id
left join payments as p on p.order_id = o.order_id
left join rates as r
    on r.channel_code = o.channel_code
   and o.order_date >= r.effective_from
   and o.order_date <  coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')

files.dbt/models/hr/dim_hr_employee.sql:
/*
  Dimensi karyawan untuk analitik: employee_key = hash ber-salt dari employee_id (tidak bisa di-join ke
  direktori restricted maupun ke cashier_id di data POS). Usia & masa kerja hanya dalam bentuk band.
*/
with employees as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_hr__employees') }}
),

today as (
    select current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') as d
)

select
    {{ hash_pii('e.employee_id') }}                                             as employee_key,
    e.outlet_id,
    e.job_role,
    e.employment_type,
    e.gender,
    case
        when extract(year from t.d) - e.birth_year < 25 then '< 25'
        when extract(year from t.d) - e.birth_year < 35 then '25-34'
        when extract(year from t.d) - e.birth_year < 45 then '35-44'
        else '45+'
    end                                                                         as age_band,
    e.hire_source,
    e.hired_date,
    e.terminated_date,
    e.termination_reason,
    e.is_terminated,
    date_diff(coalesce(e.terminated_date, t.d), e.hired_date, day)              as tenure_days,
    case
        when date_diff(coalesce(e.terminated_date, t.d), e.hired_date, day) < 90 then '< 3 bulan'
        when date_diff(coalesce(e.terminated_date, t.d), e.hired_date, day) < 365 then '3-12 bulan'
        when date_diff(coalesce(e.terminated_date, t.d), e.hired_date, day) < 730 then '1-2 tahun'
        else '2+ tahun'
    end                                                                         as tenure_band,
    e.is_terminated and date_diff(e.terminated_date, e.hired_date, day) < 90    as is_early_attrition
from employees as e
cross join today as t

files.dbt/models/hr/mart_hr_compensation_month:
/*
  Grain   : period_month x outlet_id x job_role x employment_type
  Privasi : agregat gaji (rata-rata, median, compa-ratio, total biaya) di-NULL-kan bila headcount_paid
            < var('hr_k_anonymity_min') (k-anonymity). Headcount & jam lembur tetap tampil.
  Compa   : rata-rata gaji pokok / titik tengah band pasar (seed hr_salary_bands); < 0.90 = di bawah pasar.
*/
{{ config(post_hook = "{{ hr_outlet_row_access() }}") }}

with payroll as (
    select * from {{ ref('rst_hr__payroll') }}
),

employees as (
    select employee_id, job_role, employment_type from {{ ref('stg_hr__employees') }}
),

overtime as (
    select
        employee_id,
        date_trunc(work_date, month)    as period_month,
        sum(overtime_hours)             as overtime_hours
    from {{ ref('stg_hr__attendance') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

bands as (
    select * from {{ ref('hr_salary_bands') }}
),

grouped as (
    select
        p.period_month,
        p.outlet_id,
        e.job_role,
        e.employment_type,
        count(distinct p.employee_id)                                   as headcount_paid,
        sum(p.gross_pay)                                                as gross_payroll_cost,
        sum(p.overtime_pay)                                             as overtime_pay,
        sum(coalesce(o.overtime_hours, 0))                              as overtime_hours,
        avg(p.base_pay)                                                 as avg_base_pay,
        approx_quantiles(p.base_pay, 2)[offset(1)]                      as median_base_pay
    from payroll as p
    inner join employees as e on p.employee_id = e.employee_id
    left join overtime as o
        on
            p.employee_id = o.employee_id
            and p.period_month = o.period_month
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)

select
    g.period_month,
    g.outlet_id,
    g.job_role,
    g.employment_type,
    g.headcount_paid,
    g.overtime_hours,
    round(safe_divide(g.overtime_hours, g.headcount_paid), 1)                   as overtime_hours_per_head,
    g.headcount_paid < {{ var('hr_k_anonymity_min', 3) }}                       as is_suppressed,
    {{ k_anon('round(g.gross_payroll_cost, 0)', 'g.headcount_paid') }}          as gross_payroll_cost,
    {{ k_anon('round(g.overtime_pay, 0)', 'g.headcount_paid') }}                as overtime_pay,
    {{ k_anon('round(g.avg_base_pay, 0)', 'g.headcount_paid') }}                as avg_base_pay,
    {{ k_anon('round(g.median_base_pay, 0)', 'g.headcount_paid') }}             as median_base_pay,
    {{ k_anon('round(safe_divide(g.avg_base_pay, b.band_mid), 3)', 'g.headcount_paid') }}
                                                                                as compa_ratio
from grouped as g
left join bands as b
    on
        g.job_role = b.job_role
        and g.employment_type = 'Full-time'
files.dbt/models/hr/mart_hr_headcount_turnover:
/*
  Grain   : report_month x outlet_id x employment_type
  Turnover: terminations / rata-rata (opening, closing) headcount. Early attrition = keluar < 90 hari.
*/
{{ config(post_hook = "{{ hr_outlet_row_access() }}") }}

with employees as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_hr_employee') }}
),

months as (
    select distinct date_trunc(date_day, month) as report_month
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }}
    where date_day between {{ var('start_date') }} and current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}')
),

grid as (
    select m.report_month, o.outlet_id, t.employment_type
    from months as m
    cross join (select distinct outlet_id from employees) as o
    cross join (select distinct employment_type from employees) as t
),

calc as (
    select
        g.report_month,
        g.outlet_id,
        g.employment_type,
        countif(
            e.hired_date < g.report_month
            and (e.terminated_date is null or e.terminated_date >= g.report_month)
        )                                                                       as opening_headcount,
        countif(date_trunc(e.hired_date, month) = g.report_month)               as hires,
        countif(date_trunc(e.terminated_date, month) = g.report_month)          as terminations,
        countif(
            date_trunc(e.terminated_date, month) = g.report_month and e.termination_reason = 'Resign'
        )                                                                       as voluntary_terminations,
        countif(
            date_trunc(e.terminated_date, month) = g.report_month and e.is_early_attrition
        )                                                                       as early_attrition
    from grid as g
    left join employees as e
        on
            g.outlet_id = e.outlet_id
            and g.employment_type = e.employment_type
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    *,
    opening_headcount + hires - terminations                                    as closing_headcount,
    {{ safe_pct('terminations', '(opening_headcount + (opening_headcount + hires - terminations)) / 2') }}
                                                                                as turnover_pct
from calc
files.dbt/models/hr/mart_hr_labor_cost_monthly:
/*
  Grain : period_month x outlet_id. Payroll aktual (HR) vs anggaran LABOR di operating_expenses (Finance) dan
          terhadap net sales. Level outlet (>= 8 orang) sehingga total tidak membuka gaji individu.
*/
{{ config(post_hook = "{{ hr_outlet_row_access() }}") }}

with payroll as (
    select
        period_month,
        outlet_id,
        sum(gross_pay)                  as payroll_cost,
        sum(overtime_pay)               as overtime_pay,
        count(distinct employee_id)     as headcount_paid
    from {{ ref('rst_hr__payroll') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

labor_budget as (
    select
        period_month,
        outlet_id,
        sum(amount)                     as labor_opex
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__operating_expenses') }}
    where category_code = 'LABOR'
    group by 1, 2
),

sales as (
    select report_month, outlet_id, net_sales
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_monthly') }}
)

select
    p.period_month,
    p.outlet_id,
    p.headcount_paid,
    round(p.payroll_cost, 0)                                            as payroll_cost,
    round(p.overtime_pay, 0)                                            as overtime_pay,
    round(b.labor_opex, 0)                                              as labor_opex,
    round(p.payroll_cost - b.labor_opex, 0)                             as payroll_vs_opex_gap,
    {{ safe_pct('p.payroll_cost', 's.net_sales') }}                     as payroll_pct_of_net_sales,
    {{ safe_pct('p.overtime_pay', 'p.payroll_cost') }}                  as overtime_pct_of_payroll
from payroll as p
left join labor_budget as b
    on
        p.period_month = b.period_month
        and p.outlet_id = b.outlet_id
left join sales as s
    on
        p.period_month = s.report_month
        and p.outlet_id = s.outlet_id
files.dbt/models/hr/mart_hr_recruitment_source:
/*
  Grain  : applied_quarter x application_source (seluruh outlet; volume per outlet terlalu kecil)
  Retensi: hires_left_within_90d dihitung hanya untuk hire yang sudah >= 90 hari sejak mulai (cohort matang).
*/
with applications as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_hr__job_applications') }}
),

hires as (
    select employee_id, hired_date, terminated_date
    from {{ ref('stg_hr__employees') }}
),

today as (
    select current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') as d
)

select
    date_trunc(date(a.applied_at_local), quarter)                               as applied_quarter,
    a.application_source,
    count(*)                                                                    as applications,
    countif(a.is_screened)                                                      as screened,
    countif(a.is_interviewed)                                                   as interviewed,
    countif(a.is_offered)                                                       as offered,
    countif(a.is_hired)                                                         as hired,
    {{ safe_pct('countif(a.is_hired)', 'count(*)') }}                           as application_to_hire_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('countif(a.is_hired)', 'countif(a.is_offered)') }}              as offer_acceptance_pct,
    round(avg(if(a.is_hired, date_diff(date(a.decided_at_local), date(a.applied_at_local), day), null)), 1)
                                                                                as avg_days_apply_to_accept,
    countif(h.employee_id is not null and date_diff(t.d, h.hired_date, day) >= 90)
                                                                                as hires_matured_90d,
    countif(
        h.employee_id is not null
        and date_diff(t.d, h.hired_date, day) >= 90
        and h.terminated_date is not null
        and date_diff(h.terminated_date, h.hired_date, day) < 90
    )                                                                           as hires_left_within_90d
from applications as a
cross join today as t
left join hires as h on a.hired_employee_id = h.employee_id
group by 1, 2
files.dbt/models/hr/mart_hr_workforce_semiannu:
/*
  Grain   : review_period x outlet_id x job_role. Disiplin (absensi) vs hasil review kinerja.
  Privasi : rating rata-rata di-NULL-kan bila jumlah karyawan ter-review < var('hr_k_anonymity_min').
*/
{{ config(post_hook = "{{ hr_outlet_row_access() }}") }}

{% set periods = var('hr_review_periods') %}

with periods as (
    {% for p in periods %}
        select '{{ p.period }}' as review_period, date '{{ p.start }}' as period_start, date '{{ p.end }}' as period_end
        {% if not loop.last %}union all{% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
),

attendance as (
    select
        p.review_period,
        a.employee_id,
        a.outlet_id,
        countif(a.status in ('Present', 'Late'))                    as days_worked,
        countif(a.status = 'Late')                                  as days_late,
        countif(a.status = 'Absent')                                as days_absent,
        count(*)                                                    as days_scheduled,
        sum(a.overtime_hours)                                       as overtime_hours
    from {{ ref('stg_hr__attendance') }} as a
    inner join periods as p on a.work_date between p.period_start and p.period_end
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

reviews as (
    select * from {{ ref('rst_hr__performance_reviews') }}
),

employees as (
    select employee_id, job_role from {{ ref('stg_hr__employees') }}
),

grouped as (
    select
        a.review_period,
        a.outlet_id,
        e.job_role,
        count(distinct a.employee_id)                               as headcount,
        count(r.review_id)                                          as reviewed,
        sum(a.days_scheduled)                                       as days_scheduled,
        sum(a.days_worked)                                          as days_worked,
        sum(a.days_late)                                            as days_late,
        sum(a.days_absent)                                          as days_absent,
        sum(a.overtime_hours)                                       as overtime_hours,
        avg(r.rating)                                               as avg_rating,
        avg(r.goals_met_pct)                                        as avg_goals_met_pct
    from attendance as a
    inner join employees as e on a.employee_id = e.employee_id
    left join reviews as r
        on
            a.employee_id = r.employee_id
            and a.review_period = r.review_period
    group by 1, 2, 3
)

select
    review_period,
    outlet_id,
    job_role,
    headcount,
    reviewed,
    {{ safe_pct('days_worked', 'days_scheduled') }}                         as attendance_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('days_late', 'days_worked') }}                              as late_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('days_absent', 'days_scheduled') }}                         as absence_pct,
    round(safe_divide(overtime_hours, headcount), 1)                        as overtime_hours_per_head,
    reviewed < {{ var('hr_k_anonymity_min', 3) }}                           as is_rating_suppressed,
    {{ k_anon('round(avg_rating, 2)', 'reviewed') }}                        as avg_rating,
    {{ k_anon('round(avg_goals_met_pct, 1)', 'reviewed') }}                 as avg_goals_met_pct
from grouped
files.dbt/models/intermediate/costing/_costing:
version: 2

models:
  - name: int_item_explosion_daily
    description: >
      Explosion BOM harian per item (menu, modifier, prep, ingredient) ke bahan raw, diurai rekursif
      (WITH RECURSIVE) berapa pun tingkat prep-nya. Versi resep dipilih per tanggal.
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [date_day, item_type, item_id, ingredient_id]
    columns:
      - name: ingredient_id
        description: >
          Bahan raw. NULL = porsi BOM yang tidak bisa diurai (prep tanpa resep aktif, siklus BOM,
          atau melewati var('bom_max_depth')).
        data_tests:
          - not_null:
              config:
                severity: error
      - name: qty_per_unit
        description: Qty bruto bahan (base uom) per 1 unit item, sudah termasuk loss_pct di setiap level.
      - name: bom_depth
        description: Level terdalam jalur BOM menuju bahan ini (1 = komponen langsung, 0 = baris Ingredient).
        data_tests:
          - dbt_utils.accepted_range:
              min_value: 0
              max_value: "{{ var('bom_max_depth') }}"

  - name: int_item_std_cost_daily
    description: Standard cost harian per item (menu, modifier, prep, ingredient).
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [date_day, item_type, item_id]
    columns:
      - name: n_components_missing_cost
        description: Jumlah komponen tanpa standard cost. Wajib 0 agar HPP akurat.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              values: [0]
              quote: false
files.dbt/models/intermediate/costing/int_item:
/*
  Grain   : date_day x item_type x item_id x ingredient_id (bahan raw)
  item_type: 'Menu Item' | 'Modifier' | 'Prep Item' | 'Ingredient'
  Rumus   : qty bruto per unit = qty_per_yield / (1 - loss_pct/100) / yield_qty, dikalikan sepanjang jalur BOM
  BOM     : diurai rekursif (WITH RECURSIVE) sampai bahan raw, berapa pun tingkatnya
            (mis. Menu -> PRP_BUMBU -> PRP_BWGOR -> ING_SHALLOT). Resep dipilih per tanggal (versi berlaku).
  Guard   : prep yang tidak bisa diurai (tanpa resep aktif, siklus, atau > var('bom_max_depth')) keluar dengan
            ingredient_id NULL → gagal test not_null di sini & n_components_missing_cost di std cost.
            Tidak pernah hilang diam-diam.
*/
with recursive

dates as (
    select date_day
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }}
    where date_day between {{ var('start_date') }} and current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}')
),

ingredients as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }}
),

recipes as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }}
),

recipe_lines as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipe_lines') }}
),

modifier_lines as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__modifier_lines') }}
),

recipe_lines_on_day as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        if(r.menu_item_id is not null, 'Menu Item', 'Prep Item') as item_type,
        coalesce(r.menu_item_id, r.prep_ingredient_id) as item_id,
        rl.ingredient_id as component_id,
        rl.qty_per_yield / (1 - rl.loss_pct / 100) / r.yield_qty as qty_per_unit
    from dates as d
    inner join recipes as r
        on
            d.date_day >= r.effective_from
            and d.date_day < coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
    inner join recipe_lines as rl
        on r.recipe_id = rl.recipe_id
),

modifier_lines_on_day as (
    select
        d.date_day,
        'Modifier' as item_type,
        ml.modifier_id as item_id,
        ml.ingredient_id as component_id,
        ml.qty_delta as qty_per_unit
    from dates as d
    cross join modifier_lines as ml
),

first_level as (
    select * from recipe_lines_on_day
    union all
    select * from modifier_lines_on_day
),

-- edge prep -> komponen (raw atau prep lain) yang berlaku per tanggal
prep_edges as (
    select
        date_day,
        item_id as prep_id,
        component_id,
        qty_per_unit
    from recipe_lines_on_day
    where item_type = 'Prep Item'
),

bom as (
    -- anchor: komponen langsung dari resep menu / prep / modifier
    select
        date_day,
        item_type,
        item_id,
        component_id,
        qty_per_unit,
        1 as bom_level,
        concat(item_id, '>', component_id) as node_key,
        cast(null as string) as parent_key
    from first_level

    union all

    -- recursive: bila komponen adalah prep, turunkan ke komponen resep prep-nya
    select
        b.date_day,
        b.item_type,
        b.item_id,
        e.component_id,
        b.qty_per_unit * e.qty_per_unit as qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level + 1 as bom_level,
        concat(b.node_key, '>', e.component_id) as node_key,
        b.node_key as parent_key
    from bom as b
    inner join prep_edges as e
        on
            b.date_day = e.date_day
            and b.component_id = e.prep_id
    where
        b.bom_level < {{ var('bom_max_depth', 10) }}
        and e.component_id not in unnest(split(b.node_key, '>'))   -- putus siklus
),

leaves as (
    -- 1) daun bahan raw
    select
        b.date_day,
        b.item_type,
        b.item_id,
        b.component_id as ingredient_id,
        b.qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level
    from bom as b
    inner join ingredients as i
        on
            b.component_id = i.ingredient_id
            and not i.is_prep_item

    union all

    -- 2) edge prep yang tidak terurai → ingredient_id NULL (ditangkap test not_null & missing cost):
    --    prep tanpa resep aktif (e NULL), atau edge yang diputus siklus / bom_max_depth (c NULL)
    select
        b.date_day,
        b.item_type,
        b.item_id,
        cast(null as string) as ingredient_id,
        b.qty_per_unit * coalesce(e.qty_per_unit, cast(1 as numeric)) as qty_per_unit,
        b.bom_level + if(e.prep_id is null, 0, 1) as bom_level
    from bom as b
    inner join ingredients as i
        on
            b.component_id = i.ingredient_id
            and i.is_prep_item
    left join prep_edges as e
        on
            b.date_day = e.date_day
            and b.component_id = e.prep_id
    left join bom as c
        on
            b.date_day = c.date_day
            and b.item_type = c.item_type
            and b.node_key = c.parent_key
            and e.component_id = c.component_id
    where
        e.prep_id is null
        or c.node_key is null

    union all

    -- 3) bahan raw sebagai dirinya sendiri (untuk valuasi waste & stock)
    select
        d.date_day,
        'Ingredient' as item_type,
        i.ingredient_id as item_id,
        i.ingredient_id,
        cast(1 as numeric) as qty_per_unit,
        0 as bom_level
    from dates as d
    cross join ingredients as i
    where not i.is_prep_item
),

final as (
    select
        date_day,
        item_type,
        item_id,
        ingredient_id,
        sum(qty_per_unit) as qty_per_unit,
        max(bom_level) as bom_depth
    from leaves
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)

-- wajib diakhiri `select * from final`: lihat macro bigquery__get_unit_test_sql
select * from final

/*
  Grain  : date_day x item_type x item_id
  Isi    : standard cost per 1 unit item = Σ qty bahan raw × standard cost bahan yang berlaku hari itu
  Kontrol: n_components_missing_cost wajib 0 (test) → mencegah HPP diam-diam terlalu rendah
*/
with explosion as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_item_explosion_daily') }}
),

costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredient_standard_costs') }}
)

select
    e.date_day,
    e.item_type,
    e.item_id,
    sum(e.qty_per_unit * c.standard_cost_per_base_uom)  as std_cost_per_unit,
    count(*)                                            as n_components,
    countif(c.ingredient_id is null)                    as n_components_missing_cost
from explosion as e
left join costs as c
    on c.ingredient_id = e.ingredient_id
   and e.date_day >= c.effective_from
   and e.date_day <  coalesce(c.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
group by 1, 2, 3
files.dbt/models/marts/_marts__models.yml:
version: 2

models:
  - name: mart_pnl_daily
    description: P&L harian per outlet berbasis standard cost dan theoretical cost of sales.
    config:
      tags: ["finance", "daily", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [report_date, outlet_id]

  - name: mart_inventory_variance
    description: Rekonsiliasi variance inventori teoritis vs aktual per periode stock count.
    config:
      tags: ["operations", "mart"]
    columns:
      - name: inventory_period_key
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - unique

  - name: mart_pnl_monthly
    description: P&L bulanan per outlet berbasis actual cost of sales (termasuk variance stock opname).
    config:
      tags: ["finance", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [report_month, outlet_id]

  - name: mart_kpi_monthly_status
    description: Status evaluasi KPI bulanan (OK/WARN/CRITICAL) terhadap threshold target.
    config:
      tags: ["finance", "mart"]
    columns:
      - name: status
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              values: ['OK', 'WARN', 'CRITICAL']

  - name: mart_menu_engineering
    description: Matriks Menu Engineering Kasavana-Smith (Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle, Dog).
    config:
      tags: ["operations", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [report_month, outlet_id, menu_item_id]

  - name: mart_waste_analysis
    description: Analisis waste per outlet, tanggal, alasan, dan kategori.
    config:
      tags: ["operations", "daily", "mart"]
    columns:
      - name: waste_cost
        data_tests:
          - not_null

  - name: mart_channel_performance_daily
    description: Kinerja sales channel harian per outlet (net sales, komisi, diskon platform).
    config:
      tags: ["operations", "daily", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [order_date, outlet_id, channel_code]

  - name: mart_orders_hourly
    description: Distribusi order per jam untuk heatmap traffic operasional.
    config:
      tags: ["operations", "daily", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [outlet_id, channel_code, day_of_week_num, order_hour_local]

  - name: mart_category_performance_daily
    description: Kinerja harian per kategori produk (net sales, cogs, gross margin, unit sold) untuk analisis kontribusi kategori.
    config:
      tags: ["sales", "finance", "daily", "mart"]
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [report_date, outlet_id, category_name]

  - name: mart_inventory_position_daily
    description: >
      Posisi stok harian per outlet (nilai stok, hari stok berbobot nilai, susut opname, jumlah bahan kritis)
      dari fct_inventory_balance_daily. Sumber tab "Stok & Susut" dashboard Vercel.
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [balance_date, outlet_id]
    columns:
      - name: shrinkage_value
        description: Nilai susut opname (Rp) pada hari opname; positif = stok hilang, negatif = surplus.

  - name: mart_inventory_ingredient_status
    description: >
      Status stok terkini per outlet x bahan (Habis / Kritis / Risiko Kedaluwarsa / Tidak Bergerak / Normal)
      plus kinerja susut 90 hari. Sumber tabel status bahan di dashboard.
    data_tests:
      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
          combination_of_columns: [outlet_id, ingredient_id]
    columns:
      - name: stock_status
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              values: ['Habis', 'Kritis', 'Risiko Kedaluwarsa', 'Tidak Bergerak', 'Normal']
      - name: shrinkage_pct_90d
        description: Susut 90 hari sebagai % dari pemakaian teoretis (sales + waste); positif = stok hilang.
files.dbt/models/marts/mart_category_performan:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'report_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'category_name'],
    tags = ['sales', 'finance', 'daily', 'mart']
) }}

with lines as (
    select
        f.order_date                                as report_date,
        f.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized')  as category_name,
        count(*)                                    as line_count,
        sum(f.qty)                                  as units_sold,
        sum(f.gross_sales_amount)                   as gross_sales,
        sum(f.merchant_discount_amount)            as discounts,
        sum(f.cogs_std_amount)                     as cogs_standard
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as f
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on f.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where f.is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

refund_lines as (
    -- Item-level refund
    select
        r.refund_date as report_date,
        r.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized') as category_name,
        r.refund_net_amount as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on l.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is not null

    union all

    -- Order-level refund dialokasikan ke masing-masing item sesuai proporsi net_sales
    select
        r.refund_date as report_date,
        r.outlet_id,
        coalesce(m.category_name, 'Uncategorized') as category_name,
        r.refund_net_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(l.net_sales_amount, o.net_sales_amount), 0) as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
        on o.order_id = r.order_id
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_id = r.order_id and l.is_revenue_line
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m
        on l.menu_item_id = m.menu_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is null
),

category_refunds as (
    select
        report_date,
        outlet_id,
        category_name,
        sum(refund_amount) as refunds
    from refund_lines
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

keys as (
    select report_date, outlet_id, category_name from lines
    union distinct
    select report_date, outlet_id, category_name from category_refunds
)

select
    k.report_date,
    k.outlet_id,
    k.category_name,
    coalesce(l.line_count, 0)                                   as line_count,
    coalesce(l.units_sold, 0)                                   as units_sold,
    round(coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0), 0)                        as gross_sales,
    round(coalesce(l.discounts, 0), 0)                          as discounts,
    round(coalesce(r.refunds, 0), 0)                            as refunds,
    round(coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(l.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0), 0) as net_sales,
    round(coalesce(l.cogs_standard, 0), 0)                      as cogs_standard,
    round((coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(l.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0)) - coalesce(l.cogs_standard, 0), 0) as gross_profit,
    {{ safe_pct('coalesce(l.cogs_standard, 0)', 'coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(l.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0)') }} as food_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('(coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(l.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0)) - coalesce(l.cogs_standard, 0)', 'coalesce(l.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(l.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0)') }} as gross_margin_pct
from keys as k
left join lines as l
    on l.report_date = k.report_date
   and l.outlet_id = k.outlet_id
   and l.category_name = k.category_name
left join category_refunds as r
    on r.report_date = k.report_date
   and r.outlet_id = k.outlet_id
   and r.category_name = k.category_name

files.dbt/models/marts/mart_inventory_ingredie:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['inventory', 'mart']
) }}
/*
  Grain  : outlet_id x ingredient_id, posisi pada tanggal saldo terakhir + kinerja susut 90 hari
  Status : Habis (saldo <= 0) > Kritis (macro is_stock_critical) > Risiko Kedaluwarsa (hari stok > shelf life)
           > Tidak Bergerak (tanpa pemakaian 28 hari) > Normal
*/
with balance as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_inventory_balance_daily') }}
),

as_of as (
    select max(balance_date) as as_of_date from balance
),

window_90d as (
    select
        b.outlet_id,
        b.ingredient_id,
        sum(b.theoretical_sales_qty + b.waste_qty)                  as usage_qty_90d,
        -sum(coalesce(b.count_variance_qty, 0))                     as shrinkage_qty_90d,
        -sum(coalesce(b.count_variance_qty, 0) * b.std_cost_per_unit) as shrinkage_value_90d
    from balance as b
    cross join as_of as a
    where b.balance_date > date_sub(a.as_of_date, interval 90 day)
    group by 1, 2
),

latest as (
    select b.*
    from balance as b
    inner join as_of as a on b.balance_date = a.as_of_date
),

ingredients as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_ingredient') }}
)

select
    l.balance_date                                                  as as_of_date,
    l.outlet_id,
    l.ingredient_id,
    i.ingredient_name,
    i.ingredient_category,
    i.base_uom,
    i.is_perishable,
    i.shelf_life_days,
    l.on_hand_qty,
    l.avg_daily_usage_28d,
    l.days_on_hand,
    l.on_hand_value,
    l.last_count_date,
    l.days_since_last_count,
    w.usage_qty_90d,
    w.shrinkage_qty_90d,
    w.shrinkage_value_90d,
    {{ safe_pct('w.shrinkage_qty_90d', 'w.usage_qty_90d') }}        as shrinkage_pct_90d,
    case
        when l.on_hand_qty <= 0 then 'Habis'
        when {{ is_stock_critical('l.days_on_hand', 'l.avg_daily_usage_28d', 'i.shelf_life_days') }} then 'Kritis'
        when i.shelf_life_days is not null and l.days_on_hand > i.shelf_life_days then 'Risiko Kedaluwarsa'
        when coalesce(l.avg_daily_usage_28d, 0) = 0 then 'Tidak Bergerak'
        else 'Normal'
    end                                                             as stock_status
from latest as l
inner join window_90d as w
    on
        l.outlet_id = w.outlet_id
        and l.ingredient_id = w.ingredient_id
left join ingredients as i
    on l.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id

) }}
/*
  Grain  : balance_date x outlet_id (ringkasan fct_inventory_balance_daily untuk dashboard)
  Susut  : shrinkage_value = -Σ(count_variance_qty × std cost) pada hari opname; positif = stok hilang.
  Hari stok outlet = on_hand_value / avg_daily_usage_value_28d (dibobot nilai, bukan rata-rata per bahan).
*/
with balance as (
    select
        b.*,
        i.shelf_life_days
    from {{ ref('fct_inventory_balance_daily') }} as b
    left join {{ ref('dim_ingredient') }} as i
        on b.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
)

select
    balance_date,
    outlet_id,
    sum(on_hand_value)                                                          as on_hand_value,
    sum(purchased_amount)                                                       as purchased_amount,
    sum((theoretical_sales_qty + waste_qty) * std_cost_per_unit)                as usage_value,
    sum(avg_daily_usage_28d * std_cost_per_unit)                                as avg_daily_usage_value_28d,
    safe_divide(
        sum(on_hand_value),
        sum(avg_daily_usage_28d * std_cost_per_unit)
    )                                                                           as days_on_hand,
    -sum(coalesce(count_variance_qty, 0) * std_cost_per_unit)                   as shrinkage_value,
    countif(counted_qty is not null) > 0                                        as is_count_day,
    countif({{ is_stock_critical('days_on_hand', 'avg_daily_usage_28d', 'shelf_life_days') }}) as n_ingredients_critical,
    countif(is_negative_on_hand)                                                as n_ingredients_negative
from balance
group by 1, 2
files.dbt/models/marts/mart_inventory_variance:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['inventory', 'mart']
) }}

with raw_counts as (
    -- bahan raw langsung
    select
        c.outlet_id,
        c.ingredient_id,
        c.count_date,
        c.counted_qty_base
    from {{ ref('fct_stock_counts') }} as c
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i
        on i.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id
       and not i.is_prep_item

    union all

    -- prep item diurai ke ekuivalen bahan raw
    select
        c.outlet_id,
        x.ingredient_id,
        c.count_date,
        c.counted_qty_base * x.qty_per_unit as counted_qty_base
    from {{ ref('fct_stock_counts') }} as c
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i
        on i.ingredient_id = c.ingredient_id
       and i.is_prep_item
    inner join {{ ref('int_item_explosion_daily') }} as x
        on x.date_day = c.count_date
       and x.item_type = 'Prep Item'
       and x.item_id = c.ingredient_id
),

counts as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        count_date,
        sum(counted_qty_base) as counted_qty_base
    from raw_counts
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

periods as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        ingredient_id,
        lag(count_date) over w          as period_start,
        count_date                      as period_end,
        lag(counted_qty_base) over w    as opening_qty,
        counted_qty_base                as closing_qty
    from counts
    window w as (partition by outlet_id, ingredient_id order by count_date)
),

period_movements as (
    select
        p.outlet_id,
        p.ingredient_id,
        p.period_end,
        sum(coalesce(m.purchased_qty, 0))           as purchased_qty,
        sum(coalesce(m.purchased_amount, 0))        as purchased_amount,
        sum(coalesce(m.theoretical_sales_qty, 0))   as theoretical_sales_qty,
        sum(coalesce(m.waste_qty, 0))               as recorded_waste_qty
    from periods as p
    left join {{ ref('fct_inventory_movements_daily') }} as m
        on m.outlet_id = p.outlet_id
       and m.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and m.movement_date > p.period_start
       and m.movement_date <= p.period_end
    where p.period_start is not null
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

costs as (
    select date_day, item_id as ingredient_id, std_cost_per_unit
    from {{ ref('int_item_std_cost_daily') }}
    where item_type = 'Ingredient'
),

calc as (
    select
        p.outlet_id,
        p.ingredient_id,
        p.period_start,
        p.period_end,
        p.opening_qty,
        pm.purchased_qty,
        pm.purchased_amount,
        p.closing_qty,
        p.opening_qty + pm.purchased_qty - p.closing_qty                    as actual_usage_qty,
        pm.theoretical_sales_qty,
        pm.recorded_waste_qty,
        p.opening_qty + pm.purchased_qty - p.closing_qty
            - pm.theoretical_sales_qty - pm.recorded_waste_qty              as unexplained_variance_qty,
        c.std_cost_per_unit
    from periods as p
    inner join period_movements as pm
        on pm.outlet_id = p.outlet_id
       and pm.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and pm.period_end = p.period_end
    left join costs as c
        on c.ingredient_id = p.ingredient_id
       and c.date_day = p.period_end
)

select
    {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['outlet_id', 'ingredient_id', 'period_end']) }} as inventory_period_key,
    *,
    unexplained_variance_qty * std_cost_per_unit                                         as unexplained_variance_value,
    theoretical_sales_qty * std_cost_per_unit                                            as theoretical_usage_value,
    {{ safe_pct('unexplained_variance_qty', 'theoretical_sales_qty') }}                  as unexplained_variance_pct
from calc

with base as (
