        cast(channel_cost_pct as numeric) as channel_cost_pct
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_monthly') }}
),

kpi as (
    select report_month, outlet_id, is_complete_month, metric_code, metric_value
    from base
    unpivot (metric_value for metric_code in (
        food_cost_pct, waste_pct, prime_cost_pct, gross_margin_pct, inventory_variance_pct, channel_cost_pct
    ))
),

outlets as (
    select outlet_id, outlet_type from {{ ref('dim_outlet') }}
),

thresholds as (
    select * from {{ ref('kpi_thresholds') }}
)

select
    k.report_month,
    k.outlet_id,
    k.is_complete_month,
    k.metric_code,
    t.metric_name,
    t.direction,
    k.metric_value,
    t.warn_threshold,
    t.critical_threshold,
    case
        when k.metric_code = 'inventory_variance_pct' and abs(k.metric_value) >= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when k.metric_code = 'inventory_variance_pct' and abs(k.metric_value) >= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        when t.direction = 'higher_is_worse' and k.metric_value >= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when t.direction = 'higher_is_worse' and k.metric_value >= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        when t.direction = 'lower_is_worse'  and k.metric_value <= t.critical_threshold then 'CRITICAL'
        when t.direction = 'lower_is_worse'  and k.metric_value <= t.warn_threshold     then 'WARN'
        else 'OK'
    end as status
from kpi as k
left join outlets as o on o.outlet_id = k.outlet_id
inner join thresholds as t
    on t.metric_code = k.metric_code
   and coalesce(t.outlet_type, 'ALL') in (o.outlet_type, 'ALL')
   and k.report_month >= t.effective_from
   and k.report_month <  coalesce(t.effective_to, date '9999-12-31')
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by k.report_month, k.outlet_id, k.metric_code
    order by if(t.outlet_type = o.outlet_type, 1, 2)
) = 1
files.dbt/models/marts/mart_menu_engineering.s:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['menu', 'mart']
) }}

with lines as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        date_trunc(order_date, month)   as report_month,
        menu_item_id,
        sum(qty)                        as qty_sold,
        sum(net_sales_amount)           as gross_net_sales,
        sum(cogs_std_amount)            as cogs_standard
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

refund_lines as (
    -- Item-level refund
    select
        date_trunc(r.refund_date, month) as report_month,
        r.outlet_id,
        l.menu_item_id,
        r.refund_net_amount as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    where r.order_item_id is not null

    union all

    -- Order-level refund dialokasikan ke masing-masing item sesuai proporsi net_sales
    select
        date_trunc(r.refund_date, month) as report_month,
        r.outlet_id,
        l.menu_item_id,
        r.refund_net_amount * coalesce(safe_divide(l.net_sales_amount, o.net_sales_amount), 0) as refund_amount
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
        on o.order_id = r.order_id
    inner join {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }} as l
        on l.order_id = r.order_id and l.is_revenue_line
    where r.order_item_id is null
),

item_refunds as (
    select
        report_month,
        outlet_id,
        menu_item_id,
        sum(refund_amount) as refunds
    from refund_lines
    group by 1, 2, 3
),

items as (
    select
        l.outlet_id,
        l.report_month,
        l.menu_item_id,
        l.qty_sold,
        l.gross_net_sales - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) as net_sales,
        l.cogs_standard
    from lines as l
    left join item_refunds as r
        on r.report_month = l.report_month
       and r.outlet_id = l.outlet_id
       and r.menu_item_id = l.menu_item_id
),

calc as (
    select
        *,
        safe_divide(net_sales - cogs_standard, qty_sold)                                    as avg_contribution_margin,
        safe_divide(qty_sold, sum(qty_sold) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month))    as menu_mix_pct,
        count(*) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month)                                as n_items_sold,
        safe_divide(
            sum(net_sales - cogs_standard) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month),
            sum(qty_sold) over (partition by outlet_id, report_month)
        )                                                                                   as weighted_avg_cm
    from items
),

flags as (
    select
        *,
        menu_mix_pct >= 0.7 / n_items_sold          as is_high_popularity,
        avg_contribution_margin >= weighted_avg_cm  as is_high_profitability
    from calc
)

select
    f.*,
    case
        when is_high_popularity and is_high_profitability then 'Star'
        when is_high_popularity then 'Plowhorse'
        when is_high_profitability then 'Puzzle'
        else 'Dog'
    end                                                         as menu_class,
    d.menu_name,
    d.category_name
from flags as f
left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as d on d.menu_item_id = f.menu_item_id

files.dbt/models/marts/mart_pnl_daily.sql:
{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'report_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id'],
    tags = ['finance', 'mart']
) }}

with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') - 1) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

outlet_days as (
    select d.date_day as report_date, o.outlet_id
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    cross join max_data_date as m
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__outlets') }} as o
        on d.date_day between o.opened_date
                          and coalesce(o.closed_date, m.max_date)
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
      and d.date_day <= m.max_date

    union all

    select d.date_day as report_date, 'Unallocated' as outlet_id
    from {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
    cross join max_data_date as m
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
      and d.date_day <= m.max_date
      and exists (
          select 1 from {{ ref('fct_opex_allocated_monthly') }}
          where outlet_id = 'Unallocated'
            and period_month = date_trunc(d.date_day, month)
      )
),

sales as (
    select
        order_date                      as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        sum(gross_sales_amount)         as gross_sales,
        sum(merchant_discount_amount)   as discounts,
        sum(cogs_std_amount)            as cogs_standard,
        sum(qty)                        as units_sold
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1, 2
),

orders as (
    select
        order_date                          as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        count(*)                            as order_count,
        sum(channel_commission_amount)      as channel_commission,
        sum(payment_fee_amount)             as payment_fees
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
    where order_status = 'Completed'
    group by 1, 2
),

refunds as (
    select
        refund_date as report_date,
        outlet_id,
        sum(refund_net_amount) as refunds,
        sum(refund_tax_amount) as tax_refunds
    from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

waste as (
    select waste_date as report_date, outlet_id, sum(waste_cost_amount) as waste_cost
    from {{ ref('fct_waste') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

opex_daily as (
    select
        period_month,
        outlet_id,
        sum(if(pnl_line = 'Labor', allocated_amount, 0)) / nullif(any_value(active_days_in_month), 0)   as labor_cost,
        sum(if(pnl_line != 'Labor', allocated_amount, 0)) / nullif(any_value(active_days_in_month), 0)  as other_opex,
        logical_or(is_opex_estimated)                                                                     as is_opex_estimated
    from {{ ref('fct_opex_allocated_monthly') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

joined as (
    select
        od.report_date,
        date_trunc(od.report_date, month)                                   as report_month,
        od.outlet_id,
        coalesce(o.order_count, 0)                                          as order_count,
        coalesce(s.units_sold, 0)                                           as units_sold,
        coalesce(s.gross_sales, 0)                                          as gross_sales,
        coalesce(s.discounts, 0)                                            as discounts,
        coalesce(r.refunds, 0)                                              as refunds,
        coalesce(s.gross_sales, 0) - coalesce(s.discounts, 0) - coalesce(r.refunds, 0) as net_sales,
        coalesce(s.cogs_standard, 0)                                        as cogs_standard,
        coalesce(w.waste_cost, 0)                                           as waste_cost,
        coalesce(o.channel_commission, 0)                                   as channel_commission,
        coalesce(o.payment_fees, 0)                                         as payment_fees,
        coalesce(x.labor_cost, 0)                                           as labor_cost,
        coalesce(x.other_opex, 0)                                           as other_opex,
        coalesce(x.is_opex_estimated, false)                                as is_opex_estimated
    from outlet_days as od
    left join sales as s on s.report_date = od.report_date and s.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join orders as o on o.report_date = od.report_date and o.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join refunds as r on r.report_date = od.report_date and r.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join waste as w on w.report_date = od.report_date and w.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
    left join opex_daily as x
        on x.outlet_id = od.outlet_id
       and x.period_month = date_trunc(od.report_date, month)
),

calc as (
    select
        *,

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    tags = ['finance', 'mart']
) }}

with daily as (
    select * from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }}
),

variance as (
    select
        outlet_id,
        date_trunc(period_end, month)       as report_month,
        sum(unexplained_variance_value)     as inventory_variance_cost
    from {{ ref('mart_inventory_variance') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

monthly as (
    select
        report_month,
        outlet_id,
        count(*)                        as reported_days,
        sum(order_count)                as order_count,
        sum(gross_sales)                as gross_sales,
        sum(discounts)                  as discounts,
        sum(refunds)                    as refunds,
        sum(net_sales)                  as net_sales,
        sum(cogs_standard)              as cogs_standard,
        sum(waste_cost)                 as waste_cost,
        sum(channel_commission)         as channel_commission,
        sum(payment_fees)               as payment_fees,
        sum(labor_cost)                 as labor_cost,
        sum(other_opex)                 as other_opex,
        logical_or(is_opex_estimated)   as is_opex_estimated
    from daily
    group by 1, 2
),

calc as (
    select
        m.*,
        m.report_month < date_trunc(current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}'), month)    as is_complete_month,
        coalesce(v.inventory_variance_cost, 0)                                      as inventory_variance_cost,
        m.cogs_standard + m.waste_cost                                              as theoretical_cost_of_sales,
        m.cogs_standard + m.waste_cost + coalesce(v.inventory_variance_cost, 0)     as actual_cost_of_sales
    from monthly as m
    left join variance as v on v.outlet_id = m.outlet_id and v.report_month = m.report_month
),

pnl as (
    select
        *,
        net_sales - actual_cost_of_sales                                            as gross_profit,
        net_sales - actual_cost_of_sales - channel_commission - payment_fees
            - labor_cost - other_opex                                               as outlet_ebitda
    from calc
)

select
    *,
    {{ safe_pct('theoretical_cost_of_sales', 'net_sales') }}        as theoretical_food_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('actual_cost_of_sales', 'net_sales') }}             as food_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('waste_cost', 'net_sales') }}                       as waste_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('inventory_variance_cost', 'net_sales') }}          as inventory_variance_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('actual_cost_of_sales + labor_cost', 'net_sales') }} as prime_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('gross_profit', 'net_sales') }}                     as gross_margin_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('channel_commission', 'net_sales') }}               as channel_cost_pct,
    {{ safe_pct('outlet_ebitda', 'net_sales') }}                    as ebitda_margin_pct
from pnl

{{ config(
    materialized = 'table',
    partition_by = {'field': 'waste_date', 'data_type': 'date', 'granularity': 'month'},
    cluster_by = ['outlet_id', 'reason_code'],
    tags = ['inventory', 'mart']
) }}

with waste as (
    select
        w.outlet_id,
        w.waste_date,
        w.reason_code,
        w.reason_name,
        w.controllability,
        case
            when w.item_type = 'Menu Item' then coalesce(m.category_name, 'Finished Menu')
            when w.item_type = 'Prep Item' then 'Prep Batch'
            else coalesce(i.ingredient_category, 'Raw Ingredient')
        end as item_category,
        sum(w.qty)                  as waste_qty,
        sum(w.waste_cost_amount)    as waste_cost
    from {{ ref('fct_waste') }} as w
    left join {{ ref('dim_menu_item') }} as m on m.menu_item_id = w.item_id and w.item_type = 'Menu Item'
    left join {{ ref('dim_ingredient') }} as i on i.ingredient_id = w.item_id and w.item_type in ('Ingredient', 'Prep Item')
    group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
),

pnl as (
    select
        report_date,
        outlet_id,
        net_sales
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }}
)

select
    w.outlet_id,
    w.waste_date,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_name,
    w.controllability,
    w.item_category,
    w.waste_qty,
    w.waste_cost,
    p.net_sales as outlet_daily_net_sales,
    {{ safe_pct('w.waste_cost', 'p.net_sales') }} as waste_pct_of_sales
from waste as w
left join pnl as p on p.report_date = w.waste_date and p.outlet_id = w.outlet_id

salt_val as (
    select any_value(salt) as salt
    from `{{ target.project }}.{{ var('secrets_dataset') }}.pii_salt`
),

normalized as (
    select
        customer_id,
        -- normalisasi format Indonesia ke E.164 (+62...)
        regexp_replace(trim(phone_number), r'^08', '+628') as norm_phone,
        lower(trim(email))                                 as norm_email,

        registered_at,
        deleted_at,

    from source
)

select

    if(n.norm_phone is null, null, to_hex(sha256(concat(n.norm_phone, s.salt)))) as phone_hash,
    if(n.norm_email is null, null, to_hex(sha256(concat(n.norm_email, s.salt)))) as email_hash,
    extract(year from n.birth_date)                                               as birth_year,
    {{ to_local_datetime('n.registered_at') }}                                    as registered_at_local,
    n.deleted_at is not null                                                      as is_deleted,
    n.updated_at                                                                  as updated_at_utc
from normalized as n
cross join salt_val as s

files.dbt/tests/assert_active_prep_components_:
-- Memastikan setiap komponen prep item dalam resep menu/modifier aktif memiliki resep prep aktif pada setiap tanggal aktifnya
with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}')) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

active_prep_components as (
    select
        r.effective_from,
        coalesce(r.effective_to, date '9999-12-31') as effective_to,
        rl.ingredient_id as prep_id
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }} as r
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__recipe_lines') }} as rl on rl.recipe_id = r.recipe_id
    inner join {{ ref('stg_pos__ingredients') }} as i on i.ingredient_id = rl.ingredient_id
    where i.is_prep_item
),

prep_recipes as (
    select
        prep_ingredient_id as prep_id,
        effective_from,
        coalesce(effective_to, date '9999-12-31') as effective_to
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__recipes') }}
    where prep_ingredient_id is not null
),

component_days as (
    select distinct
        c.prep_id,
        d.date_day
    from active_prep_components as c
    cross join max_data_date as m
    inner join {{ ref('util_dates') }} as d
        on d.date_day between c.effective_from and least(c.effective_to, m.max_date)
    where d.date_day >= {{ var('start_date') }}
)

select
    cd.prep_id,
    cd.date_day
from component_days as cd
left join prep_recipes as p
    on p.prep_id = cd.prep_id
   and cd.date_day >= p.effective_from
   and cd.date_day < p.effective_to
where p.prep_id is null

-- tests/assert_incremental_facts_in_sync.sql : jaring pengaman model incremental.
-- Setiap order / order item di staging harus ada di fact dengan versi terbaru (updated_at tidak lebih baru
-- dari source_updated_at_utc), dan fact tidak boleh berisi baris yang sudah tidak ada di source.
with stg_orders as (
    select order_id, updated_at_utc from {{ ref('stg_pos__orders') }}
),

stg_items as (
    select order_item_id, updated_at_utc from {{ ref('stg_pos__order_items') }}
),

fct_orders as (
    select order_id, source_updated_at_utc from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),

fct_lines as (
    select order_item_id, source_updated_at_utc from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
)

select 'fct_orders' as model, coalesce(s.order_id, f.order_id) as id,
    case
        when f.order_id is null then 'missing in fact'
        when s.order_id is null then 'not in source'
        else 'stale'
    end as issue
from stg_orders as s
full outer join fct_orders as f on f.order_id = s.order_id
where f.order_id is null
   or s.order_id is null
   or s.updated_at_utc > f.source_updated_at_utc

union all

select 'fct_order_lines' as model, coalesce(s.order_item_id, f.order_item_id) as id,
    case
        when f.order_item_id is null then 'missing in fact'
        when s.order_item_id is null then 'not in source'
        else 'stale'
    end as issue
from stg_items as s
full outer join fct_lines as f on f.order_item_id = s.order_item_id

-- tests/assert_inventory_balance_reconciles_variance.sql : dua jalur hitung harus sepakat.
-- Saldo harian (perpetual, reset tiap opname) vs mart variance (periode antar-opname):
-- count_variance_qty pada tanggal opname = -unexplained_variance_qty periode yang berakhir di tanggal itu.
select
    v.outlet_id,
    v.ingredient_id,
    v.period_end,
    v.unexplained_variance_qty,
    b.count_variance_qty
from {{ ref('mart_inventory_variance') }} as v
left join {{ ref('fct_inventory_balance_daily') }} as b
    on
        v.outlet_id = b.outlet_id
        and v.ingredient_id = b.ingredient_id
        and v.period_end = b.balance_date
where
    b.count_variance_qty is null
    or abs(v.unexplained_variance_qty + b.count_variance_qty) > 0.001
files.dbt/tests/assert_opex_reconciles.sql:
-- tests/assert_opex_reconciles.sql : opex di mart_pnl_daily = opex sumber, untuk bulan lengkap
with max_data_date as (
    select coalesce(max(order_date), current_date('{{ var("local_tz") }}') - 1) as max_date
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
),
mart as (
    select m.report_month, sum(m.labor_cost + m.other_opex) as opex
    from {{ ref('mart_pnl_daily') }} as m
    cross join max_data_date as x
    where m.report_month < date_trunc(x.max_date, month)
      and not coalesce(m.is_opex_estimated, false)
    group by 1
),
src as (
    select period_month as report_month, sum(amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('stg_pos__operating_expenses') }}
    group by 1
)
select
    m.report_month,
    m.opex as mart_opex,
    s.opex as source_opex
from mart as m
inner join src as s on s.report_month = m.report_month
where abs(coalesce(m.opex, 0) - coalesce(s.opex, 0)) > 1
-- tests/assert_order_totals_reconcile.sql
-- Memastikan total amount order sama dengan:
-- net_sales_amount - platform_funded_discount_amount + service_charge_amount + tax_amount
-- Catatan: net_sales_amount sengaja tidak mengurangi diskon yang didanai platform (merchant tetap diakui pendapatannya),
-- namun total_amount yang dibayar pelanggan mengurangi seluruh diskon (merchant + platform).
with line_totals as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(net_sales_amount) as total_net_lines,
        sum(platform_funded_discount_amount) as total_platform_discounts
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    where is_revenue_line
    group by 1
),

orders as (
    select
        o.order_id,
        o.total_amount,
        o.service_charge_amount,
        o.tax_amount,
        coalesce(l.total_net_lines, 0) as total_net_lines,
        coalesce(l.total_platform_discounts, 0) as total_platform_discounts,
        coalesce(l.total_net_lines, 0) - coalesce(l.total_platform_discounts, 0)
            + o.service_charge_amount + o.tax_amount as calculated_total
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as o
    left join line_totals as l on l.order_id = o.order_id
    where o.order_status = 'Completed'
)

select
    order_id,
    total_amount,
    calculated_total,
    abs(total_amount - calculated_total) as diff
from orders
where abs(total_amount - calculated_total) > 1

files.infra/bootstrap_gcp.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Bootstrap GCP untuk F&B Data Platform (plan v2.1, §6).
# Idempotent: aman dijalankan ulang. Tidak membuat JSON key (semua keyless via WIF).
#
# Prasyarat (manual, sekali):
#   1. Project GCP sudah dibuat dan billing sudah di-link   (plan §6.1)
#   2. gcloud auth login && gcloud auth application-default login
#   3. export GCP_PROJECT_ID=... GITHUB_REPO=owner/repo     (lihat .env.example)
#
# Opsional: GCP_BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID (untuk membuat budget alert), GCP_REGION.
set -euo pipefail

: "${GCP_PROJECT_ID:?set GCP_PROJECT_ID}"
: "${GITHUB_REPO:?set GITHUB_REPO (format owner/repo)}"
REGION="${GCP_REGION:-asia-southeast2}"
PROJECT="$GCP_PROJECT_ID"
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

log() { printf '\n==> %s\n' "$*"; }

log "Project: $PROJECT | region: $REGION | repo: $GITHUB_REPO"
gcloud config set project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null
PROJECT_NUMBER="$(gcloud projects describe "$PROJECT" --format='value(projectNumber)')"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- API
log "Aktifkan API"
gcloud services enable \
  bigquery.googleapis.com \
  iamcredentials.googleapis.com \
  sts.googleapis.com \
  cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com \
  billingbudgets.googleapis.com \
  --project "$PROJECT"

# ------------------------------------------------------------ Service account
SERVICE_ACCOUNTS=(sa-ingest sa-dbt sa-github-ci sa-export)
log "Service account"
for sa in "${SERVICE_ACCOUNTS[@]}"; do
  if ! gcloud iam service-accounts describe "$sa@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gcloud iam service-accounts create "$sa" --display-name "$sa (fnb data platform)" --project "$PROJECT"
  fi
done

# Role level project (minimal). Akses data diberikan per dataset di bigquery_setup.sql.
grant_project_role() {
  gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding "$PROJECT" \
    --member "serviceAccount:$1@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
    --role "$2" --condition=None --quiet >/dev/null
}
log "Role project"
grant_project_role sa-ingest roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-dbt    roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-export roles/bigquery.jobUser
grant_project_role sa-github-ci roles/bigquery.user        # boleh membuat dataset CI per PR

# ------------------------------------------------------ Workload Identity Federation
log "Workload Identity Federation (GitHub Actions, tanpa key)"
if ! gcloud iam workload-identity-pools describe github --location=global --project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gcloud iam workload-identity-pools create github --location=global --project "$PROJECT" \
    --display-name "GitHub Actions"
fi
if ! gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers describe github-oidc \
     --location=global --workload-identity-pool=github --project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gcloud iam workload-identity-pools providers create-oidc github-oidc \
    --location=global --workload-identity-pool=github --project "$PROJECT" \
    --issuer-uri="https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" \
    --attribute-mapping="google.subject=assertion.sub,attribute.repository=assertion.repository,attribute.repository_id=assertion.repository_id,attribute.ref=assertion.ref" \
    --attribute-condition="assertion.repository=='${GITHUB_REPO}'"
fi

# sa-github-ci dapat diimpersonasi oleh repo ini (seluruh branch / PR)
PRINCIPAL_REPO="principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_NUMBER}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github/attribute.repository/${GITHUB_REPO}"
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding "sa-github-ci@$PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \

files.infra/restrict_raw_ci_access.py:
"""Tutup akses CI ke data mentah ber-PII tanpa mematikan slim CI.

1. Authorized dataset: view di dataset `stg` diizinkan membaca `raw_fnb` atas nama pembacanya. CI (dan pembaca
   stg lain) tetap bisa query view staging yang sudah dikurasi - PII dibuang / di-hash - tanpa akses raw.
2. Cabut READER sa-github-ci dari `raw_fnb` (grant manual yang bertentangan dengan bigquery_setup.sql).

Urutan sengaja: otorisasi dulu, baru cabut, sehingga tidak ada jeda CI tidak bisa membaca stg.
Idempoten; update memakai etag.

Konsekuensi: CI tidak bisa membangun model yang membaca raw langsung (models/staging, models/hr/restricted);
pr_ci.yml mengecualikannya dari build dan hanya meng-compile-nya.

Pemakaian:  set -a && source .env && set +a && python3 infra/restrict_raw_ci_access.py
"""
import os
import sys

from google.cloud import bigquery

RAW_DATASETS = ["raw_fnb"]
AUTHORIZED_VIEW_DATASET = "stg"
CI_SA = "sa-github-ci@{project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"


def is_authorized(entry, project, dataset_id):
    if entry.entity_type != "dataset":
        return False
    ref = (entry.entity_id or {}).get("dataset", {})
    return ref.get("projectId") == project and ref.get("datasetId") == dataset_id


def main():
    project = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID") or sys.exit("GCP_PROJECT_ID belum diset.")
    client = bigquery.Client(project=project)
    ci_sa = CI_SA.format(project=project)
    for raw in RAW_DATASETS:
        ds = client.get_dataset(f"{project}.{raw}")
        entries = list(ds.access_entries)
        if any(is_authorized(e, project, AUTHORIZED_VIEW_DATASET) for e in entries):
            print(f"{raw}: dataset {AUTHORIZED_VIEW_DATASET} sudah ter-otorisasi, dilewati.")
        else:
            entries.append(bigquery.AccessEntry(
                role=None, entity_type="dataset",
                entity_id={"dataset": {"projectId": project, "datasetId": AUTHORIZED_VIEW_DATASET},
                           "targetTypes": ["VIEWS"]}))
            ds.access_entries = entries
            ds = client.update_dataset(ds, ["access_entries"])
            print(f"{raw}: view di dataset {AUTHORIZED_VIEW_DATASET} di-otorisasi.")

        keep = [e for e in ds.access_entries if not (e.entity_type == "userByEmail" and e.entity_id == ci_sa)]
        if len(keep) == len(ds.access_entries):
            print(f"{raw}: {ci_sa} tidak punya akses langsung, dilewati.")
        else:
            ds.access_entries = keep
            client.update_dataset(ds, ["access_entries"])
            print(f"{raw}: akses langsung {ci_sa} dicabut.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Cabut akses bawaan `projectReaders` dari dataset BigQuery yang berisi PII.

Dataset baru otomatis memberi READER ke projectReaders, sehingga siapa pun dengan role Viewer di level project
bisa membaca isinya. Dataset ber-PII hanya boleh dibaca principal yang di-grant eksplisit.
projectWriters/projectOwners (Editor/Owner project) sengaja dipertahankan sebagai akses administratif.
Idempoten; update memakai etag sehingga gagal bila ACL diubah bersamaan.

Pemakaian:  set -a && source .env && set +a && python3 infra/revoke_project_readers.py raw_fnb raw_fnb_staging hr_restricted
"""
import os
import sys

from google.cloud import bigquery


def revoke(client, project, dataset_id):
    ds = client.get_dataset(f"{project}.{dataset_id}")
    keep = [e for e in ds.access_entries
            if not (e.entity_type == "specialGroup" and e.entity_id == "projectReaders")]
    if len(keep) == len(ds.access_entries):
        print(f"{dataset_id}: projectReaders sudah tidak ada, dilewati.")
        return
    ds.access_entries = keep
    client.update_dataset(ds, ["access_entries"])
    print(f"{dataset_id}: projectReaders dicabut.")


def main():
    datasets = sys.argv[1:]
    if not datasets:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    project = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID") or os.environ.get("PROJECT")
    if not project:
        sys.exit("GCP_PROJECT_ID belum diset.")
    client = bigquery.Client(project=project)
    for dataset_id in datasets:
        revoke(client, project, dataset_id)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Setup akses HR (opsi B): dua service account demo sebagai pengganti grup HR Manager & HR Analyst,
# lalu menjalankan infra/hr_access.sql dengan placeholder terisi. Idempoten: aman dijalankan ulang.
#
#   sa-hr-manager-demo  -> baca hr_restricted (PII & gaji individual) + hr
#   sa-hr-analyst-demo  -> baca hr saja (ter-masking)
#
# Akun gcloud yang menjalankan script ini (owner project) diberi roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator pada
# kedua SA agar bisa mengimpersonasi mereka di scripts/verify_hr_rbac.py.
#
# Pemakaian (dari root repo):  set -a && source .env && set +a && bash infra/setup_hr_demo.sh
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT="${GCP_PROJECT_ID:?GCP_PROJECT_ID belum diset (source .env)}"
REGION="${GCP_REGION:-asia-southeast2}"
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ME="$(gcloud config get-value account 2>/dev/null)"
[[ -n "$ME" ]] || { echo "gcloud belum login (gcloud auth login)"; exit 1; }
if [[ "$ME" == *.gserviceaccount.com ]]; then ME_MEMBER="serviceAccount:$ME"; else ME_MEMBER="user:$ME"; fi

MANAGER_SA="sa-hr-manager-demo@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
ANALYST_SA="sa-hr-analyst-demo@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

log() { printf '\n==> %s\n' "$*"; }

# IAM eventually consistent: SA yang baru dibuat bisa belum dikenali policy binding selama beberapa detik.
retry() {
  local n
  for n in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
    if "$@"; then return 0; fi
    echo "   belum berhasil (percobaan $n/8), tunggu 10 detik..." >&2
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "Gagal setelah 8 percobaan: $*" >&2
  return 1
}

log "Service account demo"
for name in sa-hr-manager-demo sa-hr-analyst-demo; do
  email="${name}@${PROJECT}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  if gcloud iam service-accounts describe "$email" --project "$PROJECT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "$name sudah ada, dilewati."
  else
    gcloud iam service-accounts create "$name" --project "$PROJECT" \
      --display-name "Demo RBAC HR (${name#sa-hr-})" --quiet
  fi
done

log "Izin menjalankan query (roles/bigquery.jobUser, level project)"
for email in "$MANAGER_SA" "$ANALYST_SA"; do
  retry gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding "$PROJECT" --member "serviceAccount:${email}" \
    --role roles/bigquery.jobUser --condition None --quiet >/dev/null
  echo "jobUser -> $email"
done

log "Impersonasi untuk verifikasi: $ME_MEMBER -> tokenCreator pada kedua SA"
for email in "$MANAGER_SA" "$ANALYST_SA"; do
  retry gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding "$email" --project "$PROJECT" \
    --member "$ME_MEMBER" --role roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator --quiet >/dev/null
  echo "tokenCreator pada $email"
done

log "Dataset hr & hr_restricted + grant (infra/hr_access.sql)"
render_sql() {
sed -e "s/<PROJECT_ID>/${PROJECT}/g" \
    -e "s/<REGION>/${REGION}/g" \
    -e "s/group:<HR_MANAGER_GROUP>/serviceAccount:${MANAGER_SA}/g" \
    -e "s/group:<HR_ANALYST_GROUP>/serviceAccount:${ANALYST_SA}/g" \
    "$HERE/hr_access.sql"
}
run_sql() { render_sql | bq query --project_id="$PROJECT" --location="$REGION" --use_legacy_sql=false --quiet; }
retry run_sql

log "Cabut akses bawaan projectReaders dari hr_restricted"
# Dataset baru otomatis memberi READER ke projectReaders (semua Viewer project bisa membaca PII).
GCP_PROJECT_ID="$PROJECT" python3 "$HERE/revoke_project_readers.py" hr_restricted

log "Ringkasan akses dataset"
for ds in hr hr_restricted; do
  echo "[$ds]"
  bq show --format=json "${PROJECT}:${ds}" \
    | python3 -c "import json,sys; [print('  ', a.get('role'), a.get('userByEmail') or a.get('groupByEmail') or a.get('iamMember') or a.get('specialGroup')) for a in json.load(sys.stdin)['access']]"
done

cat <<EOF

Selesai. Langkah berikutnya:
  1. Set enable_hr: true di dbt/dbt_project.yml, commit & push ke main.
  2. Jalankan pipeline (atau tunggu jadwal 00:30 WIB).
  3. Verifikasi RBAC:  python3 scripts/verify_hr_rbac.py
Catatan: perubahan IAM bisa butuh 1-2 menit untuk berlaku.
EOF

"""Ingest OLTP Neon (schema fnb) -> BigQuery dataset raw_fnb via dlt.

Semua tabel (29 POS + 6 HR): incremental berdasarkan updated_at, merge by primary key (direfleksi dari Postgres).
Memakai BigQuery load jobs (gratis, bukan streaming insert).
"""
import os
import sys
import dlt
from dlt.sources.sql_database import sql_database

TABLES = [
    "outlets", "employees", "customers", "sales_channels", "channel_commission_rates", "promotions",
    "menu_categories", "menu_items", "menu_item_prices", "modifiers", "modifier_lines",
    "ingredients", "ingredient_standard_costs", "suppliers", "recipes", "recipe_lines",
    "orders", "order_items", "order_item_modifiers", "payments", "refunds",
    "goods_receipts", "goods_receipt_lines", "stock_counts", "stock_count_lines",
    "waste_reasons", "waste_logs", "expense_categories", "operating_expenses",
    # modul HR (005_hr.sql) - berisi PII & data gaji; hanya boleh dibaca dbt (sa-dbt) dan dataset hr_restricted
    "employee_compensation", "attendance", "payroll", "performance_reviews", "job_requisitions", "job_applications",
]


# tabel -> kolom NOT NULL yang ditambahkan lewat migration setelah tabel pertama kali di-ingest
ADDED_NOT_NULL_COLUMNS = {
    "employees": ["employment_type"],          # 005_hr.sql
}


def get_db_credentials() -> str:
    url = os.environ.get("SOURCE_DATABASE_URL")
    if not url:
        sys.exit("SOURCE_DATABASE_URL belum diset.")
    if url.startswith("postgresql://"):
        return url.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+psycopg2://", 1)
    return url


def main() -> None:
    db_uri = get_db_credentials()
    project_id = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "fnb-data-platform")
    location = os.environ.get("GCP_REGION", "asia-southeast2")

    print(f"Menjalankan dlt pipeline Postgres -> BigQuery [{project_id}:{location} / raw_fnb]...")

    source = sql_database(
        credentials=db_uri,
        schema="fnb",
        table_names=TABLES,
        backend="pyarrow",
        reflection_level="full_with_precision",
    )

    for name in TABLES:
        # Incremental berdasarkan updated_at, merge by PK dari Postgres
        # lag=3600.0 (1 jam) memastikan commit lambat tetap terbaca
        source.resources[name].apply_hints(
            incremental=dlt.sources.incremental("updated_at", lag=3600.0),
            write_disposition="merge",
        )

    # Kolom NOT NULL yang ditambahkan ke tabel yang SUDAH ada di BigQuery (ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... NOT NULL
    # DEFAULT di Postgres) harus di-ingest sebagai nullable: BigQuery menolak menambah kolom REQUIRED ke tabel
    # yang sudah ada ("Cannot add required fields to an existing schema"). Tabel baru tidak terpengaruh.
    for name, cols in ADDED_NOT_NULL_COLUMNS.items():
        source.resources[name].apply_hints(columns={c: {"name": c, "nullable": True} for c in cols})

    destination = dlt.destinations.bigquery(location=location)

    pipeline = dlt.pipeline(
        pipeline_name="fnb_pos_to_bigquery",
        destination=destination,
        dataset_name="raw_fnb",
    )

    load_info = pipeline.run(source)
    print(load_info)
    load_info.raise_on_failed_jobs()
    print("Ingestion selesai dengan sukses!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Simulasi HR & Talent (deterministik) untuk schema fnb: PII karyawan, kompensasi, absensi, payroll,
review kinerja, requisition dan lamaran kerja.

Setiap acak di-seed per entitas/tanggal (bukan per urutan), sehingga simulasi s.d. tanggal E selalu
menghasilkan histori yang sama untuk tanggal <= E. `sync()` membangun ulang "dunia HR" s.d. `end` lalu
meng-upsert: baris baru disisipkan, baris yang berubah (mis. lamaran yang maju tahap, karyawan resign)
diperbarui dan updated_at dinaikkan, baris yang sama persis tidak disentuh (ramah dlt incremental).

Event yang terjadi setelah `end` tidak terlihat: tahapan rekrutmen di masa depan = NULL / 'In Process',
karyawan yang belum mulai kerja belum dibuat, kenaikan gaji baru muncul setelah review dilakukan.
"""
import datetime as dt
import math
from collections import defaultdict

FEMALE = {"Siti", "Dewi", "Putri", "Ayu", "Nina", "Rina", "Maya", "Lestari", "Wulan", "Intan", "Sari", "Citra",
          "Anisa", "Fitri", "Mega", "Nadia", "Sinta", "Laras"}
NIK_PREFIX = {"FLG-01": "3171", "KIOSK-02": "3273", "CLOUD-03": "3174"}
SHIFT_START = {"Barista": (7, 13), "Cashier": (7, 13), "Cook": (9, 14), "Supervisor": (9, 9), "Outlet Manager": (9, 9)}


class HRSim:
    def __init__(self, cfg, rnd_for, local_dt, day_flags, first_names, last_names):
        self.cfg, self.hr = cfg, cfg["hr"]
        self.rnd_for, self.local_dt, self.day_flags = rnd_for, local_dt, day_flags
        self.first_names, self.last_names = first_names, last_names
        self.start = cfg["start_date"]
        self.closed = set(cfg["demand"]["closed_days"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ util
    def pick(self, rnd, weights):
        r, acc = rnd.random() * sum(weights.values()), 0.0
        for k, w in weights.items():
            acc += w
            if r <= acc:
                return k
        return k

    def person(self, key, outlet, first=None, last=None):
        """Atribut PII sintetis yang stabil per orang."""
        rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "person", key)
        first = first or rnd.choice(self.first_names)
        last = last or rnd.choice(self.last_names)
        gender = "F" if first in FEMALE else "M"
        birth = dt.date(1981, 1, 1) + dt.timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 365 * 25))
        dd = birth.day + (40 if gender == "F" else 0)
        nik = f"{NIK_PREFIX[outlet]}{rnd.randint(10, 99)}{dd:02d}{birth:%m%y}{rnd.randint(1, 9999):04d}"
        email = f"{first}.{last}{rnd.randint(1, 99)}@{self.hr['email_domain']}".lower()
        phone = f"0857{rnd.randint(10_000_000, 99_999_999)}"
        return {"full_name": f"{first} {last}", "phone_number": phone, "national_id": nik,
                "birth_date": birth, "gender": gender, "email": email}

    def ts(self, day, hour, minute=0):
        return self.local_dt(day, hour, minute)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ simulasi
    def run(self, core, end):
        """core: [{employee_id, outlet_id, full_name, phone_number, job_role, hired_date}] karyawan tetap di DB."""
        hr, pt = self.hr, self.hr["part_time"]
        out = defaultdict(list)
        emps = {}                                                   # employee_id -> dict
        for e in core:
            first, _, last = e["full_name"].partition(" ")
            p = self.person(e["employee_id"], e["outlet_id"], first, last or "Santoso")
            p.update(full_name=e["full_name"], phone_number=e["phone_number"])
            emps[e["employee_id"]] = dict(e, **p, employment_type="Full-time", hire_source="Initial",
                                          terminated_date=None, termination_reason=None)
        short = {o: c["short"] for o, c in self.cfg["outlets"].items()}
        seq = defaultdict(int)

        def new_pt(outlet, role, hired, source, person_key, person=None):
            seq[outlet] += 1
            eid = f"P{short[outlet]}{seq[outlet]:03d}"
            p = person or self.person(person_key, outlet)
            emps[eid] = dict(employee_id=eid, outlet_id=outlet, job_role=role, hired_date=hired, **p,
                             employment_type="Part-time", hire_source=source, terminated_date=None,
                             termination_reason=None)
            return eid

        for outlet, n in pt["headcount"].items():                  # crew awal (sebelum periode simulasi)
            for i in range(n):
                rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "pt0", outlet, i)
                new_pt(outlet, self.pick(rnd, pt["roles"]), dt.date(2025, 6, rnd.randint(2, 28)),
                       self.pick(rnd, self.hr["recruitment"]["source_weights"]), ("pt0", outlet, i))

        pending, reqs, apps = [], [], []                            # pending: (start_date, outlet, role, src, req, person)
        day = self.start
        while day <= end:
            for item in sorted([p for p in pending if p[0] == day], key=lambda p: p[4]["requisition_id"]):
                start, outlet, role, src, req, person = item
                eid = new_pt(outlet, role, start, src, None, person)
                req["filled_date"], req["filled_by_employee_id"] = start, eid
                req["_hire_app"]["hired_employee_id"] = eid
            pending = [p for p in pending if p[0] != day]
            for eid in sorted(emps):
                e = emps[eid]
                if e["employment_type"] != "Part-time" or e["terminated_date"] or e["hired_date"] >= day:
                    continue
                monthly = pt["monthly_attrition"].get(e["hire_source"], pt["monthly_attrition"]["default"])
                if (day - e["hired_date"]).days <= pt["early_tenure_days"]:
                    monthly *= 2
                hazard = 1 - (1 - monthly) ** (1 / 30)
                rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "attr", eid, day)
                if rnd.random() < hazard:
                    e["terminated_date"] = day
                    e["termination_reason"] = self.pick(rnd, pt["termination_reason"])
                    req, req_apps, hire = self.recruit(e, day, len([r for r in reqs if r["opened_date"] == day]))
                    reqs.append(req)
                    apps.extend(req_apps)
                    if hire:
                        pending.append(hire)
            day += dt.timedelta(days=1)

        # visibilitas per `end`: sembunyikan event setelah end
        end_ts = self.ts(end + dt.timedelta(days=1), 0)
        for a in apps:
            for col in ("screened_at", "interviewed_at", "offered_at", "decided_at"):
                if a[col] is not None and a[col] >= end_ts:
                    a[col] = None
            if a["decided_at"] is None:
                a["status"], a["hired_employee_id"] = "In Process", None
        out["employees"] = list(emps.values())
        out["job_requisitions"] = reqs
        out["job_applications"] = [a for a in apps if a["applied_at"] < end_ts]
        self.attendance(emps, end, out)
        self.reviews(emps, end, out)
        self.compensation(emps, end, out)
        self.payroll(emps, end, out)
        return out

    def recruit(self, leaver, opened, n_same_day):
        rc = self.hr["recruitment"]
        outlet, role = leaver["outlet_id"], leaver["job_role"]
        rid = f"REQ-{outlet}-{opened:%Y%m%d}-{n_same_day + 1}"
        rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "req", rid)
        req = dict(requisition_id=rid, outlet_id=outlet, job_role=role, employment_type="Part-time",
                   reason="Replacement", replaces_employee_id=leaver["employee_id"], opened_date=opened,
                   filled_date=None, filled_by_employee_id=None)
        apps, passed = [], []
        for i in range(rnd.randint(*rc["applications_per_requisition"])):
            ar = self.rnd_for("hr", "app", rid, i)
            src = self.pick(ar, rc["source_weights"])
            applied = self.ts(opened + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(0, rc["application_window_days"])),
                              ar.randint(8, 21), ar.randint(0, 59))
            p = self.person(("cand", rid, i), outlet)
            a = dict(application_id=f"{rid}-A{i + 1:02d}", requisition_id=rid, candidate_name=p["full_name"],
                     candidate_phone=p["phone_number"], source=src, applied_at=applied, screened_at=None,
                     interviewed_at=None, offered_at=None, decided_at=None, status="Rejected",
                     hired_employee_id=None, _person=p)
            a["screened_at"] = applied + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(1, 3), hours=ar.randint(0, 6))
            if ar.random() < rc["withdraw_prob"]:
                a["status"], a["decided_at"] = "Withdrawn", a["screened_at"]
            elif ar.random() < rc["screen_pass"][src]:
                a["interviewed_at"] = a["screened_at"] + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(2, 5))
                if ar.random() < rc["interview_pass"][src]:
                    passed.append(a)
                else:
                    a["decided_at"] = a["interviewed_at"] + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(1, 2))
            else:
                a["decided_at"] = a["screened_at"]
            apps.append(a)
        if not passed:                                              # tidak ada yang lolos: tawarkan ke yang diinterview
            passed = [a for a in apps if a["interviewed_at"] is not None] or [a for a in apps if a["status"] != "Withdrawn"]
            for a in passed:
                if a["interviewed_at"] is None:
                    a["interviewed_at"] = a["screened_at"] + dt.timedelta(days=2)
        passed.sort(key=lambda a: a["interviewed_at"])
        hire = None
        offer_at = None
        for a in passed:
            ar = self.rnd_for("hr", "offer", a["application_id"])
            offer_at = max(offer_at or a["interviewed_at"], a["interviewed_at"]) + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(1, 3))
            if hire:                                                # posisi sudah terisi
                a["status"], a["decided_at"] = "Rejected", offer_at
                continue
            a["offered_at"] = offer_at
            a["decided_at"] = offer_at + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(0, 2))
            if ar.random() < self.hr["recruitment"]["offer_accept"][a["source"]] or a is passed[-1]:
                a["status"] = "Hired"
                start = a["decided_at"].date() + dt.timedelta(days=ar.randint(*rc["start_after_accept_days"]))
                req["_hire_app"] = a
                hire = (start, outlet, role, a["source"], req, a["_person"])
            else:
                a["status"] = "Offer Declined"
            offer_at = a["decided_at"]
        return req, apps, hire

    def employed(self, e, day):
        return e["hired_date"] <= day and (e["terminated_date"] is None or day < e["terminated_date"])

    def attendance(self, emps, end, out):
        ft, pt = self.hr["full_time"], self.hr["part_time"]
        rows = out["attendance"]
        for eid in sorted(emps):
            e = emps[eid]
            is_ft = e["employment_type"] == "Full-time"
            day_off = self.rnd_for("hr", "dayoff", eid).randint(0, 6)
            shift_idx = self.rnd_for("hr", "shift", eid).randint(0, 1)
            day = max(self.start, e["hired_date"])
            while day <= end:
                if not self.employed(e, day):
                    break
                rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "att", eid, day)
                scheduled = ft["shift_hours"] if is_ft else pt["shift_hours"]
                works = (day.weekday() != day_off) if is_ft else (rnd.random() < pt["shift_prob"])
                if day in self.closed or not works:
                    day += dt.timedelta(days=1)
                    continue
                hour = SHIFT_START[e["job_role"]][shift_idx] if is_ft else (11, 16)[shift_idx]
                late, ot, status = 0, 0.0, "Present"
                if is_ft and rnd.random() < ft["leave_days_per_year"] / 313:
                    status = "Leave"
                elif rnd.random() < (ft["absent_prob"] if is_ft else pt["absent_prob"]):
                    status = "Absent"
                else:
                    if rnd.random() < (ft["late_prob"] if is_ft else pt["late_prob"]):
                        status, late = "Late", rnd.randint(5, 40)
                    if is_ft:
                        ro = ft["rainy_overtime"]
                        if (e["outlet_id"] == ro["outlet"] and e["job_role"] == ro["role"]
                                and self.day_flags(day)["rain"] and rnd.random() < ro["prob"]):
                            ot = float(rnd.randint(*ro["hours"]))
                        elif rnd.random() < ft["overtime_prob"]:
                            ot = float(rnd.randint(1, 2))
                worked = 0.0 if status in ("Absent", "Leave") else round(scheduled - late / 60 + ot, 1)
                cin = self.ts(day, hour) + dt.timedelta(minutes=late) if worked else None
                cout = self.ts(day, hour) + dt.timedelta(hours=scheduled + ot) if worked else None
                rows.append(dict(attendance_id=f"{eid}-{day:%Y%m%d}", employee_id=eid, outlet_id=e["outlet_id"],
                                 work_date=day, status=status, scheduled_hours=float(scheduled), clock_in_at=cin,
                                 clock_out_at=cout, late_minutes=late, worked_hours=worked, overtime_hours=ot))
                day += dt.timedelta(days=1)

    def reviews(self, emps, end, out):
        att = defaultdict(list)
        for a in out["attendance"]:
            att[a["employee_id"]].append(a)
        managers = {e["outlet_id"]: eid for eid, e in sorted(emps.items())
                    if e["job_role"] == "Outlet Manager" and e["employment_type"] == "Full-time"}
        for r in self.hr["reviews"]:
            if r["reviewed_on"] > end:
                continue
            for eid in sorted(emps):
                e = emps[eid]
                if not self.employed(e, r["reviewed_on"]):
                    continue
                if (r["end"] - max(r["start"], e["hired_date"])).days < 60:
                    continue
                rows = [a for a in att[eid] if r["start"] <= a["work_date"] <= r["end"]]
                if not rows:
                    continue
                late = sum(a["status"] == "Late" for a in rows) / len(rows)
                absent = sum(a["status"] == "Absent" for a in rows) / len(rows)
                rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "review", r["period"], eid)
                score = 3.8 + rnd.gauss(0, 0.7) - 8 * late - 15 * absent
                rating = int(min(5, max(1, round(score))))
                reviewer = None if e["job_role"] == "Outlet Manager" else managers.get(e["outlet_id"])
                out["performance_reviews"].append(dict(
                    review_id=f"RV-{r['period']}-{eid}", employee_id=eid, review_period=r["period"],
                    reviewer_id=reviewer, rating=rating,
                    goals_met_pct=round(min(100, max(0, 55 + 8 * rating + rnd.gauss(0, 5))), 1),
                    reviewed_at=self.ts(r["reviewed_on"], 10)))

    def compensation(self, emps, end, out):
        hr = self.hr
        ratings = {(v["employee_id"], v["review_period"]): v["rating"] for v in out["performance_reviews"]}
        raise_day = hr["annual_raise_date"]
        first_review = hr["reviews"][0]
        for eid in sorted(emps):
            e = emps[eid]
            if e["employment_type"] == "Part-time":
                out["employee_compensation"].append(dict(
                    employee_id=eid, effective_from=e["hired_date"], effective_to=None, base_salary_monthly=None,
                    hourly_rate=float(hr["part_time"]["hourly_rate"]), allowance_monthly=0.0, change_reason="Initial"))
                continue
            rnd = self.rnd_for("hr", "salary", eid)
            base = hr["base_salary"][e["job_role"]] * hr["outlet_salary_factor"][e["outlet_id"]] * rnd.gauss(1, 0.03)
            base = round(base / 50_000) * 50_000
            rows = [dict(employee_id=eid, effective_from=e["hired_date"], effective_to=None,
                         base_salary_monthly=float(base), hourly_rate=None,
                         allowance_monthly=float(hr["allowance_monthly"]), change_reason="Initial")]
            rating = ratings.get((eid, first_review["period"]))
            if rating is not None and first_review["reviewed_on"] <= end:    # kenaikan berlaku mundur ke 1 Jan
                rows[0]["effective_to"] = raise_day
                new = round(base * (1 + hr["raise_pct_by_rating"][rating] / 100) / 50_000) * 50_000
                rows.append(dict(rows[0], effective_from=raise_day, effective_to=None,
                                 base_salary_monthly=float(new), change_reason="Annual Review"))
            out["employee_compensation"].extend(rows)

    def payroll(self, emps, end, out):
        hr = self.hr
        comp = defaultdict(list)
        for c in out["employee_compensation"]:
            comp[c["employee_id"]].append(c)
        att = defaultdict(list)
        for a in out["attendance"]:
            att[(a["employee_id"], a["work_date"].replace(day=1))].append(a)
        month = self.start.replace(day=1)
        while True:
            nxt = (month + dt.timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=1)
            month_end = nxt - dt.timedelta(days=1)
            if month_end > end:
                break
            for eid in sorted(emps):
                e = emps[eid]
                if not any(self.employed(e, d) for d in (month, month_end)) and not (
                        month <= e["hired_date"] <= month_end):
                    continue
                rows = att[(eid, month)]
                c = next((c for c in comp[eid] if c["effective_from"] <= month_end
                          and (c["effective_to"] is None or month_end < c["effective_to"])), comp[eid][-1])
                if e["employment_type"] == "Full-time":
                    base = c["base_salary_monthly"]
                    hourly = base / hr["standard_hours_per_month"]
                    allow = c["allowance_monthly"]
                    ot = round(sum(a["overtime_hours"] for a in rows) * hourly * hr["overtime_multiplier"], 2)
                    absence = round(sum(a["status"] == "Absent" for a in rows) * base / 26, 2)
                    bpjs = round(base * hr["bpjs_pct"] / 100, 2)
                else:
                    base = round(sum(a["worked_hours"] for a in rows) * c["hourly_rate"], 2)
                    allow = ot = absence = bpjs = 0.0
                    if base == 0:
                        continue
                base, allow = round(base, 2), round(allow, 2)
                out["payroll"].append(dict(
                    payroll_id=f"PR-{eid}-{month:%Y%m}", employee_id=eid, outlet_id=e["outlet_id"],
                    period_month=month, base_pay=base, allowance_pay=allow, overtime_pay=ot,
                    absence_deduction=absence, bpjs_deduction=bpjs,
                    net_pay=round(base + allow + ot - absence - bpjs, 2), paid_at=self.ts(month_end, 17)))
            month = nxt

TABLES = {
    # tabel: (kolom, primary key)
    "employees": (["employee_id", "outlet_id", "full_name", "phone_number", "job_role", "hired_date",
                   "terminated_date", "national_id", "birth_date", "gender", "email", "employment_type",
                   "hire_source", "termination_reason"], ["employee_id"]),
    "employee_compensation": (["employee_id", "effective_from", "effective_to", "base_salary_monthly",
                               "hourly_rate", "allowance_monthly", "change_reason"], ["employee_id", "effective_from"]),
    "attendance": (["attendance_id", "employee_id", "outlet_id", "work_date", "status", "scheduled_hours",
                    "clock_in_at", "clock_out_at", "late_minutes", "worked_hours", "overtime_hours"], ["attendance_id"]),
    "payroll": (["payroll_id", "employee_id", "outlet_id", "period_month", "base_pay", "allowance_pay",
                 "overtime_pay", "absence_deduction", "bpjs_deduction", "net_pay", "paid_at"], ["payroll_id"]),
    "performance_reviews": (["review_id", "employee_id", "review_period", "reviewer_id", "rating",
                             "goals_met_pct", "reviewed_at"], ["review_id"]),
    "job_requisitions": (["requisition_id", "outlet_id", "job_role", "employment_type", "reason",
                          "replaces_employee_id", "opened_date", "filled_date", "filled_by_employee_id"],
                         ["requisition_id"]),
    "job_applications": (["application_id", "requisition_id", "candidate_name", "candidate_phone", "source",
                          "applied_at", "screened_at", "interviewed_at", "offered_at", "decided_at", "status",
                          "hired_employee_id"], ["application_id"]),
}


def upsert(conn, table, rows):
    """Insert baru; update hanya bila nilai berubah (updated_at dinaikkan). -> (inserted, updated)."""
    cols, pk = TABLES[table]
    if not rows:
        return 0, 0
    upd = [c for c in cols if c not in pk]
    col_list = ", ".join(cols)
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(f"create temp table _hr_stage (like fnb.{table} including defaults) on commit drop")
        with cur.copy(f"copy _hr_stage ({col_list}) from stdin") as cp:
            for r in rows:
                cp.write_row([r[c] for c in cols])
        cur.execute(f"""
            insert into fnb.{table} as t ({col_list})
            select {col_list} from _hr_stage
            on conflict ({", ".join(pk)}) do update
               set {", ".join(f"{c} = excluded.{c}" for c in upd)}, updated_at = now()
             where ({", ".join(f"t.{c}" for c in upd)}) is distinct from ({", ".join(f"excluded.{c}" for c in upd)})
            returning (xmax = 0) as inserted""")
        flags = [r[0] for r in cur.fetchall()]
        cur.execute("drop table _hr_stage")
    return sum(flags), len(flags) - sum(flags)


def sync(conn, sim, end):
    core = [dict(zip(("employee_id", "outlet_id", "full_name", "phone_number", "job_role", "hired_date"), r))
            for r in conn.execute("select employee_id, outlet_id, full_name, phone_number, job_role, hired_date "
                                  "from fnb.employees where employee_id not like 'P%' order by employee_id")]
    world = sim.run(core, end)
    summary = {}
    with conn.transaction():
        for table in TABLES:                                        # urutan aman untuk foreign key
            rows = world[table]
            if table == "job_requisitions":
                rows = [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if not k.startswith("_")} for r in rows]
            summary[table] = upsert(conn, table, rows)
    return summary

-- Sumber: fnb_data_platform_implementation_plan_v2.md §3.3 (PostgreSQL 15+; diuji di Neon).
-- Jalankan lewat: python oltp/generator/generate.py apply-schema

-- =====================================================================
-- F&B OLTP v2 — schema fnb
-- Konvensi: PK natural (VARCHAR) untuk master, IDENTITY untuk baris detail,
-- TIMESTAMPTZ untuk semua waktu, uang NUMERIC, kuantitas bahan dalam base UOM.
-- =====================================================================
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fnb;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;   -- untuk exclusion constraint periode

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fnb.set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at := now();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- ============================ ORGANISASI =============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.outlets (
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_name     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    city            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    outlet_type     VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (outlet_type IN ('Flagship', 'Kiosk', 'Cloud Kitchen')),
    seat_capacity   INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (seat_capacity >= 0),
    opened_date     DATE         NOT NULL,
    closed_date     DATE         CHECK (closed_date IS NULL OR closed_date >= opened_date),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.employees (
    employee_id     VARCHAR(10)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),
    full_name       VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,                       -- PII
    phone_number    VARCHAR(20),                                 -- PII
    job_role        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL CHECK (job_role IN ('Barista', 'Cook', 'Cashier', 'Supervisor', 'Outlet Manager')),
    hired_date      DATE         NOT NULL,
    terminated_date DATE,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.customers (
    customer_id     VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    full_name       VARCHAR(100),                                -- PII
    phone_number    VARCHAR(20)  UNIQUE,                         -- PII
    email           VARCHAR(100),                                -- PII
    birth_date      DATE,                                        -- PII
    registered_at   TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at      TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- ========================= KANAL & PROMO =============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.sales_channels (
    channel_code    VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,                    -- DINE_IN, TAKEAWAY, GOFOOD, GRABFOOD, SHOPEEFOOD
    channel_name    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    channel_group   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (channel_group IN ('Offline', 'Online Delivery')),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.channel_commission_rates (
    channel_code    VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.sales_channels (channel_code),
    effective_from  DATE         NOT NULL,
    effective_to    DATE,                                        -- eksklusif; NULL = masih berlaku
    commission_pct  NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (commission_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (channel_code, effective_from),
    CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from),
    EXCLUDE USING gist (channel_code WITH =, daterange(effective_from, effective_to) WITH &&)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.promotions (
    promo_code      VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    promo_name      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    promo_type      VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (promo_type IN ('PERCENT', 'FIXED')),
    promo_value     NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (promo_value > 0),
    funded_by       VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (funded_by IN ('Merchant', 'Platform')),
    start_date      DATE         NOT NULL,
    end_date        DATE         NOT NULL CHECK (end_date >= start_date),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- =============================== MENU ================================
CREATE TABLE fnb.menu_categories (
    category_code   VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name   VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    category_group  VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (category_group IN ('Beverage', 'Food', 'Bakery')),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.menu_items (
    menu_item_id      VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    menu_name         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    category_code     VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.menu_categories (category_code),
    launched_date     DATE         NOT NULL,
    discontinued_date DATE,
    is_active         BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at        TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.menu_item_prices (
    menu_item_id    VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.menu_items (menu_item_id),
    channel_group   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (channel_group IN ('Offline', 'Online Delivery')),
    effective_from  DATE         NOT NULL,
    effective_to    DATE,
    selling_price   NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (selling_price > 0),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (menu_item_id, channel_group, effective_from),
    CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from),
    EXCLUDE USING gist (menu_item_id WITH =, channel_group WITH =, daterange(effective_from, effective_to) WITH &&)
);

-- ========================== BAHAN & RESEP ============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.ingredients (
    ingredient_id       VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    ingredient_name     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ingredient_category VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (ingredient_category IN
                        ('Coffee', 'Dairy', 'Syrup', 'Tea', 'Bakery', 'Protein', 'Produce', 'Dry Goods', 'Packaging', 'Prep')),
    base_uom            VARCHAR(5)   NOT NULL CHECK (base_uom IN ('g', 'ml', 'pcs')),
    is_prep_item        BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,     -- TRUE = setengah jadi, dibuat dari resep prep
    is_perishable       BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    shelf_life_days     INT          CHECK (shelf_life_days > 0),
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at          TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.ingredient_standard_costs (
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    effective_from  DATE         NOT NULL,
    effective_to    DATE,
    standard_cost_per_base_uom NUMERIC(14,4) NOT NULL CHECK (standard_cost_per_base_uom >= 0),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ingredient_id, effective_from),
    CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from),
    EXCLUDE USING gist (ingredient_id WITH =, daterange(effective_from, effective_to) WITH &&)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.suppliers (
    supplier_id       VARCHAR(10)  PRIMARY KEY,
    supplier_name     VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    city              VARCHAR(50),
    payment_term_days INT          NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (payment_term_days >= 0),
    created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at        TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at        TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- Resep berversi untuk menu ATAU prep item (tepat salah satu)
CREATE TABLE fnb.recipes (
    recipe_id           VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,                -- mis. R_MNU_LATTE_V2
    menu_item_id        VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES fnb.menu_items (menu_item_id),
    prep_ingredient_id  VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    version_no          INT          NOT NULL CHECK (version_no > 0),
    yield_qty           NUMERIC(12,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (yield_qty > 0), -- menu: 1 porsi; prep: hasil batch dlm base_uom
    effective_from      DATE         NOT NULL,
    effective_to        DATE,
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (num_nonnulls(menu_item_id, prep_ingredient_id) = 1),
    CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from),
    EXCLUDE USING gist ((COALESCE(menu_item_id, prep_ingredient_id)) WITH =,
                        daterange(effective_from, effective_to) WITH &&)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.recipe_lines (
    recipe_id       VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.recipes (recipe_id),
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),  -- raw atau prep
    qty_per_yield   NUMERIC(12,4) NOT NULL CHECK (qty_per_yield > 0),                  -- qty bersih per yield_qty
    loss_pct        NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (loss_pct >= 0 AND loss_pct < 100), -- trimming/evaporasi
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (recipe_id, ingredient_id)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.modifiers (
    modifier_id     VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,                    -- MOD_EXTRA_SHOT, MOD_OAT, MOD_LARGE
    modifier_name   VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    modifier_group  VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (modifier_group IN ('Size', 'Milk', 'Sugar', 'Add-on')),
    price_delta     NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    deleted_at      TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- qty_delta boleh negatif (ganti susu: -150 ml fresh milk, +150 ml oat milk)
CREATE TABLE fnb.modifier_lines (
    modifier_id     VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.modifiers (modifier_id),
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    qty_delta       NUMERIC(12,4) NOT NULL CHECK (qty_delta <> 0),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (modifier_id, ingredient_id)
);

-- ============================ PENJUALAN ==============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.orders (
    order_id              VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,              -- {outlet}-{yyyymmdd}-{seq}
    outlet_id             VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),
    channel_code          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.sales_channels (channel_code),
    customer_id           VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES fnb.customers (customer_id),
    cashier_id            VARCHAR(10)  REFERENCES fnb.employees (employee_id),
    promo_code            VARCHAR(30)  REFERENCES fnb.promotions (promo_code),
    external_order_ref    VARCHAR(50),                           -- id GoFood/GrabFood
    ordered_at            TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    order_status          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (order_status IN ('Open', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')),
    cancelled_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
    cancel_reason         VARCHAR(100),
    guest_count           INT          CHECK (guest_count > 0),
    subtotal_amount       NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal_amount >= 0),  -- Σ qty × (unit_price + modifier)
    item_discount_amount  NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (item_discount_amount >= 0),
    order_discount_amount NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (order_discount_amount >= 0),
    service_charge_amount NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (service_charge_amount >= 0),
    tax_amount            NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tax_amount >= 0),     -- PB1
    total_amount          NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
    created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (total_amount = subtotal_amount - item_discount_amount - order_discount_amount
                          + service_charge_amount + tax_amount),
    CHECK ((order_status = 'Cancelled') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.order_items (
    order_item_id         BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id              VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.orders (order_id),
    menu_item_id          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.menu_items (menu_item_id),
    qty                   INT          NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
    unit_price            NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),  -- salinan harga saat transaksi
    line_discount_amount  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (line_discount_amount >= 0),
    line_status           VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Served' CHECK (line_status IN ('Served', 'Void')),
    void_reason           VARCHAR(100),
    created_at            TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at            TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.order_item_modifiers (
    order_item_id   BIGINT       NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.order_items (order_item_id),
    modifier_id     VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.modifiers (modifier_id),
    price_delta     NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- salinan harga modifier per unit
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (order_item_id, modifier_id)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.payments (
    payment_id      VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.orders (order_id),
    payment_method  VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN
                    ('Cash', 'QRIS', 'Debit Card', 'Credit Card', 'E-Wallet', 'Platform Settlement')),
    amount          NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
    mdr_fee_amount  NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (mdr_fee_amount >= 0),
    paid_at         TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.refunds (
    refund_id       VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.orders (order_id),
    order_item_id   BIGINT       REFERENCES fnb.order_items (order_item_id),   -- NULL = refund level order
    refund_amount   NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (refund_amount > 0),
    refund_reason   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    approved_by     VARCHAR(10)  REFERENCES fnb.employees (employee_id),
    refunded_at     TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ============================ INVENTORI ==============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.goods_receipts (
    gr_id           VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),
    supplier_id     VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.suppliers (supplier_id),
    invoice_no      VARCHAR(50),
    received_at     TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.goods_receipt_lines (
    gr_line_id      BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    gr_id           VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.goods_receipts (gr_id),
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    purchase_qty    NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL CHECK (purchase_qty > 0),
    purchase_uom    VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL,                       -- kg, liter, pack, karton
    qty_base_uom    NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL CHECK (qty_base_uom > 0), -- sudah dikonversi ke base_uom
    line_amount     NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (line_amount >= 0),
    expiry_date     DATE,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.stock_counts (
    count_id        VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),
    count_date      DATE         NOT NULL,                       -- dihitung saat tutup toko
    count_type      VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (count_type IN ('Opening', 'Weekly', 'Month End')),
    counted_by      VARCHAR(10)  REFERENCES fnb.employees (employee_id),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

);

CREATE TABLE fnb.stock_count_lines (
    count_id        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.stock_counts (count_id),
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    counted_qty_base NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL CHECK (counted_qty_base >= 0),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (count_id, ingredient_id)
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.waste_reasons (
    reason_code     VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,                    -- EXPIRED, PREP_SPOIL, DROPPED, QC_REJECT, CUST_RETURN
    reason_name     VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    controllability VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL CHECK (controllability IN ('Controllable', 'Uncontrollable')),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Waste bisa berupa bahan raw, prep item (keduanya via ingredient_id), atau produk jadi (menu_item_id)
CREATE TABLE fnb.waste_logs (
    waste_id        VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),
    logged_at       TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id   VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES fnb.ingredients (ingredient_id),
    menu_item_id    VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES fnb.menu_items (menu_item_id),
    qty             NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),      -- base_uom (bahan/prep) atau porsi (menu)
    reason_code     VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.waste_reasons (reason_code),
    recorded_by     VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.employees (employee_id),
    notes           VARCHAR(200),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CHECK (num_nonnulls(ingredient_id, menu_item_id) = 1)
);

-- ============================ KEUANGAN ===============================
CREATE TABLE fnb.expense_categories (
    category_code   VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name   VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    pnl_line        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL CHECK (pnl_line IN
                    ('Labor', 'Occupancy', 'Utilities', 'Marketing', 'Repairs & Maintenance', 'G&A')),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE fnb.operating_expenses (
    expense_id      VARCHAR(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    outlet_id       VARCHAR(10)  REFERENCES fnb.outlets (outlet_id),   -- NULL = biaya HQ/bersama (dialokasikan di dbt)
    period_month    DATE         NOT NULL CHECK (period_month = date_trunc('month', period_month)::date),
    category_code   VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL REFERENCES fnb.expense_categories (category_code),
    amount          NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
    description     VARCHAR(200),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (outlet_id, period_month, category_code)
);

CREATE INDEX ON fnb.orders (ordered_at);
CREATE INDEX ON fnb.orders (outlet_id, ordered_at);
CREATE INDEX ON fnb.order_items (order_id);
CREATE INDEX ON fnb.payments (order_id);
CREATE INDEX ON fnb.refunds (order_id);

CREATE INDEX ON fnb.waste_logs (outlet_id, logged_at);

-- Trigger updated_at + index updated_at (kursor incremental) untuk setiap tabel
DO $$
DECLARE t text;
BEGIN
    FOR t IN
        SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'fnb' AND column_name = 'updated_at'
    LOOP
        EXECUTE format('CREATE TRIGGER trg_%s_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON fnb.%I
                        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fnb.set_updated_at()', t, t);
        EXECUTE format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_%s_updated_at ON fnb.%I (updated_at)', t, t);
    END LOOP;
END $$;
